thulandra thuu.name: Thulandra Thuu
thulandra thuu.origin: ===Origins=== Thulandra Thuu was a Lemurian, coming from the shrouded isles far to the east of Khitai and remnant of a larger land. His identity and origins were unknown to all, but it was known he came from a far-distant homeland, wasn't Aquilonian nor of royal blood, and there was eventually a doubt that he was even human. It was stated by some that he was originated from Vendhya, Stygia, or Hyperborea. ===Serving Numedides=== Thulandra Thuu eventually came to "serve" King Numedides of Aquilonia, causing a drastic change in his already harsh behaviour, Thulandra Thuu presumably manipulating the monarch. Thulandra Thuu's word soon became law and even the King's chancellor took his orders from him. Thulandra Thuu was the king's right hand, wizard and counsellor in the matters of the arcane and the occult. At some point, he started teaching Alcina the arts of magic, and gave her a fragment the Mirror of Ptahmesu, for her to communicate with him through the talisman. She was seemingly his mistress. He also had a Khitan servant, Hsiao. ====Search for immortality==== Using his knowledge, magic and books (including a tome written by Guchupta of Shamballah, and the Scroll of Amendarath), and countless girls' and maidens' sacrifices (including the daughter of Captain Silvanus of the Black Dragons), Thulandra Thuu "helped" Numedides to try and obtain immortality and divinity (in fact for his own purpose), with a lack of results. ====Unrest==== He tried to have Numedides care about the public unrest and the insurrection in his kingdom (while intending to take full control of it). ====Rebellion==== When the rebellion led by Conan hid in Argos,Thulandra Thuu intercepted the message from the spy Quesado of Zingara to Vibius Latro, Chancellor to King Numedides and Chief of his Intelligence Service, and made his own moves, using Alcina (who posed as Conan's mistress) to gather information, and asking for Count Ascalante of Thune to come to him. His plots led to Conan's defeat at the crossing of the Alimane River and at his retreat. Then, he had Alcina to poison Conan with Purple Lotus and believing him dead, had General Amulius Procas and his Border Legion cross the Alimane into Argos to end the rebels. Later learning that Procas was in retreat, he appointed Ascalante to replace Procas in facade, with a more experienced Gromel as real leader. He also blackmailed Ascalante about his brother's suspect death, ordered him to obey Alcina's orders, and sent Alcina to murder Procas and make it look like a suicide. Procas was killed but Alcina's fragment of the Mirror of Ptahmesu was lost, rendering her unable to contact her master. Later, Poitain revolted against Numedides' forces, while on the same night the Border Legion was decimated by Conan's troops and followers, causing Gromel and others to surrender and join Conan while Ascalante fled the scene. Alcina finally arrived to Tarantia and informed Thulandra Thuu. Learning by her of Conan's survival and the mirror's fragment's loss, then by Hsiao of the Border Legion's stampede, Thulandra Thuu almost killed Alcina, before calming himself. He decided to have the Royal Frontiersmen led by Prince Numitor to set on the Imirian Escarpment in Poitain, to delay Conan's army in its march towards Tarantia and give enough time to Count Ulric of Raman to move his army. Thulandra Thuu went himself to Numitor, accompanied with Hsiao, leaving Alcina in Tarantia as his deputy. Catching up with Numitor, he had a few of his hunters capture satyrs for his rituals. Summoning demons, the sorcerer was able to block the pass to the rebel army. Meanwhile, Conan had recovered the fragment of the mirror, and spied upon Thulandra Thuu and Alcina during one of their conversations. Helped with the satyrs (as he had rescued one from the loyalist hunters), Conan defeated Numitor and march forward towards Tarantia. Thulandra Thuu returned to Tarantia timely to prevent Numedides from further molesting Alcina. Conan's forces soon invaded the city. The sorcerer tried to hid Numedides, Alcina and himself but his spells were negated by Dexitheus. Silvanus burst, intending to avenge his daughter, but was killed instantly. Cornered, Thulandra Thuu preferred to magically flee away, far-way, Hell being "closer than a fleeting heartbeat" compared to the place to which he went. He was spotted instants later, when the shadow of a horse and chariot with nothing to cast it. Before leaving, at some point, he attuned the Royal Lion Belt to allow him to spy on Conan. ===Return and death=== One year later, he returned in Aquilonia with his iron stallion and Hsaio, to meet with Alcina, and with conspirators against Conan (while himself still desired to become King): Commander Gromel of the Black Legion who hated the Black Dragons' commander Pallantides and wished to command both Black Dragons and Legion; Count Volmana of Karaban who wished to be reinstated in royal favour, to restore his estates to their former grandeur; and

thulsa doom.name: Thulsa Doom
thulsa doom.species: Member of the Elder Race; Undead
thulsa doom.origin: ===Origin=== Thulsa Doom was native from Grondar. He claimed to have been already old when Atlantis first rose from the ocean, and to have even died before. The Book of the Vishanti identified him as one of the last of the pre-human races dating back to the time of the Elder Gods on Earth, and he was the part of the Elder Race proper. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== In the Age of Kull, Thulsa Doom claimed to be undead, having died "as men know death" long ages ago. He is also acknowledged as the master of the Serpent-Men, who all exist to serve him. thumb|120px|as Ardyon, King of Valusia Circa 18,500 BC, Thulsa Doom regularly opposed King Kull of Valusia. Many sorcerers, including Varnae, were followers of Thulsa Doom. Eventually, under the mortal guise of Ardyon, conspiring with the Rebel Four (Baron Kaanuub, Count Ducalon of Komahar, Black Legion commander Enaros, and the poet Ridondo), Thulsa Doom managed to usurp and depose Kull, posing as Kaanuub's cousin to assert his claim to the throne as he announced his rule to the people. ====Death==== In the course of his war against wizards, Kull eventually managed to slay Thulsa Doom. Looking for vengeance, some of Doom's followers found the Chthon Scrolls and turned one of their wounded, Varnae, into the first vampire. ===Hyborian Age=== Thulsa was finally defeated when his skull and body were separated, not just through space, but time as well. Thulsa was later brought back by the Cult of Set in order to bring Set into the world by finding Conan, who had been brought back from the future along with the Savage Avengers. Thulsa then captured Conan, enacting his ritual with his blood and the blood of Conan, whom he just killed, successfully summoning Set. However, he and the cult were attacked by the Savage Avengers and a time-displaced Deathlok. And after being revived by Dagger, Conan fought and killed Thulsa.
abilities: He was able to hold his own in a against Conan or Kull.
weapons: The Fangs of Damballah: A set of twin swords of green flame, whom Thulsa Doom considered blessed by them. The Fangs could harm the very souls of its victims. Thulsa Doom originally wielded a single of those swords.

thumb.name: Thumb
thumb.origin: Thumb was a member of the 13 Ninjas who were a splinter group of the Hand who worked for Sabretooth. It was said that Thumb waited till the others were in combat to learn their foes' weakness and then strike. He was part of a collection of five of them known as the "Fingers of Sabretooth's Hand" who were sent to attack Wolverine when his Healing Factor wasn't functioning. After a short fight between the ninjas, Wolverine and Shadowcat, they injured Wolverine and fled.

thumithar.name: Thumithar
thumithar.origin: Thumithar was the father of Thongor and was part of the Black Hawk Tribe. humitar wielded a god-forged great broadsword, Sarkozan, which was passed down to his son Thongor, and had presumably been passed down from father to son for generations. It is unclear whether Thumitar perished in the battle against the Snow Bear Tribe that saw the whole of the Black Hawk Tribe, save for Thongor, perish. By the end of that battle, Thongor wielded the broadsword of his father. In later years, Thongor, when he was a thief, sometimes felt that his father would be ashamed of him.
weapons: Sarkozan, a great broadsword with eldritch runes.

thumper morgan.name: Thumper Morgan
thumper morgan.origin: "Thumper" Morgan was a prisoner at Ryker's Island. He was known for his "fists of steel". During an attempted jail break, he took on Captain America and was defeated. Captain America, wanting to check how secure the prison was by trying to escape from it, ordered himself to be locked in the cell with him. Thumper immediately attacked him, but was quickly defeated. He and Deacon planned to run away by following Cap and then killing him, but Thumper wasn't as agile and was taken back to his cell along with other prisoners.
abilities: Hand-to-hand combatant

thunder outlaw kid.name: Thunder (Outlaw Kid)
thunder outlaw kid.origin: Thunder was the first horse ridden by the Outlaw Kid, a hero of the American Frontier. Origins accounts state that the horse was a gift to him by two travelling adventurers named Emilio Diaz and Red Hawk when the Kid sought to avenge the blinding of his father and the death of his mother at the hands of Link Cado. However the true accounts of the Outlaw Kid's origins refute this. In any case, Thunder was the faithful steed of the Outlaw Kid for many years until the horse was replaced by another horse named Blazer.

thunder texas kid.name: Thunder (Texas Kid)
thunder texas kid.origin: Thunder was a horse gifted to Texas Kid by his comrades Emilio Diaz and Red Hawk to ride. The Kid first rode Thunder into Caliber City to get revenge on outlaw Link Cado who blinded the Kid's father Zane Temple and murdered his mother. Lance continued to use Thunder during his career as the Texas Kid. In order to distance himself from the Texas Kid, Lance Temple regularly hid Thunder in nearby Hidden Valley when he was not operating as the Texas Kid. Thunder was a highly intelligent horse and often came to the rescue of his master when the Texas Kid was in trouble. When the Kid was buried up to his neck in sand by the Native American renegade known as Howling Wolf, Thunder pulled the Texas Kid out of the ground, saving his life. Highly loyal, when the outlaw Brag Beaver posed as the Texas Kid tried to ride Thunder, the horse bucked him off. When Brag tied Lance to a tree and left him at the mercy of poisonous snakes, Thunder trampled the deadly reptiles under his hooves and then chewed through his masters bonds, allowing him to stop Brag Beaver. When in Mexico, the Texas Kid was captured by the evil Don Carlos who unleashed his bulls on the hero while he was tied up and helpless. Thunder came to his master's call and kept the bulls away long enough for the Kid to free himself and ultimately stop Don Carlos . Much later, Thunder was stolen by a band of Ute Native Americans, who also captured the Texas Kid. When his master and his friends were about to be trampled by wild horses, Thunder got between the wild horses and his master then helped free him so he could deal with with the Ute uprising.
abilities: Thunder was a highly intelligent horse who would come when called by a whistle. It understood basic commands from his master the Texas Kid.

thunderbird north korean mutate.name: Thunderbird (North Korean Mutate)
thunderbird north korean mutate.species: Mutate/Artificial Mutant created with the genetic material of Thunderbird and Deadpool
thunderbird north korean mutate.origin: Created by the Butler, using Deadpool's healing factor to fuse mutant genes from X-Men onto North Korean prisoners to be used as superweapons for North Korea. With the help of Kim the Nightcrawler, Deadpool freed the mutates and fought along with them against the North Korean army in order to rescue their families. Later, Captain America helped them get to China. After the health of the mutates worsened, Deadpool informed the X-Men about them, who to let them stay at the Jean Grey School, were they could be treated. However, they were hunted down in the Danger Room by the X-Men, recently turned evil by an inversion spell, and were helped by the as-well-reversed Deadpool, now going as Zenpool. They found a new home in the Monster Metropolis, the subterranean kingdom of Deadpool's wife Shiklah, where they could be treated for their health.

thungarth.name: Thungarth
thungarth.origin: Lord Thungarth was a leader of the humans during the Thousand Year War, the war opposing the humans to the Dragon Kings. Like their fellow who hid behind the walls of Althaar, Yb, and Yaodar, Thungarth and his men prayed for Father Gorm's help at Nemedis. On a storm night, Father Gorm appeared to Thungarth and, as he knew Thungarth could never defeat the Dragon Kings alone, gave him the Star Sword within it was sealed the powers of the Nineteen Gods. Using the Star Sword at Grimstrand Firth, the last battle of the war, Thungarth shattered the Dragon Kings (a few escaping), but was himself killed and the Star Sword broken.

thuron.species: Elder Race member strength-enhanced by the Black Shadow Category:Magic-Based Mutates
thuron.origin: ===Origin=== Thuron was a member of the Elder Race, and the high priest and king of a mountain city on the outer fringes of Valusia (Hyborian Age Plain of Shamu, in Ophir) during the Pre-Cataclysmic Age. He was the chief priest of the Cult of the Black Shadow and high priest of the Black Shadow who gave him strength, and the Ring of the Black Shadow allowing him to summon the "real gods". He officiated at the Temple of Everlasting Darkness. He sired a son, Thuronolos. ===End=== King Kull of Valusia decided to annihilate all those who offered human sacrifice to the dark elder gods, including Thuron's city. While Kull's army was approaching, for some reason, Thuron sworn that Gallio would be sacrificed on the altar of the Temple of Everlasting Darkness for his soul to be offered "to the devil that lurks forever in the Black Shadow". Gallio went to the temple of the forgotten Great Scorpion God to ask for help. He was rejoined by Irena, and both were found by Thuron. Demonstrating his powers, Thuron was killed by a little scorpion though to have been sent by the Scorpion God, as no scorpion had ever been found in the city and his sting killed Thuron too quickly for it to be an ordinary scorpion.
powers: Augmented Strength: He alleged that the Black Shadow had gave him strength.
weapons: Whip and short sword

thutmekri.name: Thutmekri
thutmekri.origin: Thutmekri was a Stygian who journeyed to the ancient black kingdom of Zembabwei, stole a graven golden image of their great gorilla god and then fled north, across the sprawling Iranistani desert till he crossed the nearby Ilbars River. Along the way, he purchased the gold-dressed slave girl named Helgi, to keep him warm in climates increasingly cool. He met Conan in a verdant rain forest, slayed the lakhmu which was threatening him, but, citing his disdain for barbarians, declined to help him get out a quicksand. A while later, Thutmekri was then found by Conan tied to a tree, victim of his enemy Dalboor, who was hunting him to recover the stolen idol.

tiamat annunaki.name: Tiamat (Annunaki)
tiamat annunaki.species: Primeval embodiment of the sea; ; Forebearer of the Annunaki;; Fallen angel
tiamat annunaki.origin: ===Origins=== ====Angel==== Leviathan was allegedly an angel living in Heaven. According to unconfirmed sources Leviathan became a fallen angel, cast out of Heaven, possibly for participating in Lucifer's rebellion. ====Annunaki==== According to ancient legends, dragon-like Tiamat (also known as Leviathan, the primeval embodiment of the sea, or primordial sea) mated with Apsû (the embodiment of fresh water below the earth's surface), giving birth to the first two Annunaki: Lahmu and Lahamu. They also sired Kingu. Their grandchild Anu matured, became the Annunaki Sky Father, and sired a new generation of Annunaki with Gaea. ===Annunaki Civil War=== Apsû grew annoyed by the younger generations, and planned to destroy them, but was preemptively killed by Ea. Enraged, Tiamat and Kingu, who led Tiamat's army of monster progeny (including horned serpents, snake-dragons, demonic lions, lion-men, scorpion-men, and bull-men), lay siege to Dilmun. Anu's grandson Marduk proposed to lead the armies of the Annunaki in exchange for becoming the Annunaki supreme leader, and slew Tiamat using heavenly weapons (mace, trident and axe) forged by Ningal. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Prior to the fall of Atlantis (which occurred in approximately 18,000 BC), Lilith was imprisoned inside the corpse of Tiamat by Atlantean mages. ===Modern Age=== In modern times, Tiamat's body had settled in Northern Greenland, and finally broke out of the ice. Lilith emerged from it when a group of scientists (whom she murdered) led by Dr. Phillip Henderson and Dr. Adam Brigman came to inspect the strange creature and inadvertently freed her.

tiamat champion.name: Tiamat (Champion)
tiamat champion.origin: Intergalactic holding company Landau, Luckman and Lake' prognosticators foretold a prophecy involving a celestial messiah S'Met'Kth, his herald the Mithras and Tiamat. LL&L believed the messiah would usher in a new age of galactic prosperity if he were not killed by Tiamat. The Mithras' role was to save the messiah from Tiamat. A few members of LL&L manipulated events in Deadpool's life to force him to play the role of Mithras and fulfill the prophecy. Eventually it was discovered the celestial messiah was an ancient monster who was bringing peace and bliss to the universe but in doing so was eliminating free will. This meant Tiamat was in the right and LL&L were wrong. Deadpool and Tiamat merged to defeat the messiah with Deadpool's mind controlling the gestalt being. After the messiah was destroyed, Tiamat slinked away, angry that his purpose in life had been usurped by Deadpool.

tiamok rath.origin: The Emissary is Tiamok Rath of Kharradun, an alien recruited by the Lost One to seek revenge on his creations, the Beyonders. When the Beyonder started to rewrite reality to help the Avengers gain resources to resist the Lost One's future attacks, he sent his Emissary to attack the heroes while they were on a far away planet, and attacked Captain Marvel, but despite being evenly matched she managed to escape with the help of the other Avengers. After being imprisoned by the Avengers in Avengers Mountain she waited for the arrival of the Black Order while taunting the Beyonder.

tiana sikoski.name: Tiana Sikoski
tiana sikoski.origin: Tiana was the assistant and love interest of Paul-Philip Ravage while he was director of Eco, the anti-polluter division of Alchemax. Tiana had strong feelings for Ravage and thought he was a good man, but never trusted Eco since her father was branded a polluter and carted off to Hellrock. thumb|left|Tiana Sikoski When Ravage finally started asking questions of Eco and Alchemax, he was branded a polluter as well. Tiana and the boy Dack went on the run with Ravage as he tried to bring down the MegaCorps. As a Thorite, Tiana grew up in a warrior-woman culture praising the likes of Sif and Hela, so she felt slighted having to act as Ravage's damsel-in-distress on their adventures. The two eventually parted on slightly hostile terms due to Paul-Philip unwitting mistreatment of her. Tiana came to the Church of Thor to pray for the power she desired, and was overheard by Reverend Cecil McAdam. The reverend was involved in Alchemax's plot to create their own Norse gods to counter the growing super-hero population, and offered Tiana a role in the experiments. Tiana underwent nano-technological and psychological conditioning thanks to Tyler Stone, and emerged as the Aesir known as Hela.

tiberius carr.name: Tiberius Carr
tiberius carr.origin: 33 was one of over a hundred runaways abducted by the Adrenamix Corporation (a subsidiary of the Gaulthing Corporation). Adrenamix subjected their prisoners to psionic experiments which led to a wide variety of superhuman powers. 33 could project static electricity. President and CEO Anderson Gaulthing referred to this batch of test subjects as the "Psigns of the Times". One of the Psigns was his own daughter Alison Gaulthing. Alison attempted to escape from the Adrenamix facility and the Psigns were sent to retrieve her. They chased her across a rooftop near Yancy Street, but Alison died while trying to evade capture. 33 and the others began to fear that they would be blamed for her death. Investigating the Adrenamix activities was the New Warrior known as Justice. Justice fought against the Psigns. ===After Civil War=== Tony Stark considered 33 as a potential Initiative recruit.

tick tock.name: Tick Tock
tick tock.origin: Ticktock was a mutant with the ability to perceive nearby alternate futures before they occurred. He once aspired to work as a timer at an animation studio, but was unsuccessful. Instead, Ticktock was first seen working as the weird assistant to the Locksmith, a demented escape artist, in the latter's attempt to capture all superhumans in the San Francisco area. The Locksmith believed that the abundance of superhuman feats performed by superpowered beings diminished the attention and prestige of his own talents, honed in a life of dedication, so he had a specialized prison-like building built to capture all local superhumans for three years; he often followed the trail of Spider-Woman, a local superheroine, as she led him to one target after another. As a master illusionist, the Locksmith captured his victims using his parlor tricks, so that they appeared to disappear; it is more than likely that Ticktock's powers aided in these operations. With Ticktock's help, the Locksmith was able to capture superheroes, supervillains, costumed adventurers, and other super-powered individuals. The Locksmith had Ticktock lock them in cells that the Locksmith had specifically designed to hide the power of the specific prisoner. fields.personality: Ticktock had limited combat skills, so he preferred to avoid directly participating in combat, instead providing his allies with useful information from the rear, often using his fobwatch radio. He would participate in fights if he had no other choice, and trusted his comrades, following them even on a battlefield. Ticktock was also not a leader, preferring to leave authority to others, whom he would advise to make decisions (such as Locksmith, Shroud, or Dansen Macabre), but he was efficient at working as a team with his powers: Ticktock used his powers to benefit his group's goals, which were clearly defined, even anticipating his superiors' orders or showing initiative in pointing out events of likely importance, and he was careful to give enough detail to enable his allies to act judiciously (for example, telling the Brothers Grimm which of their weapons would be most effective against the impending enemy); although he was ocasionally not explicit enough and his allies misinterpreted his words. In general, Ticktock reported what he saw, so that if he was asked about two people and he only saw one, he would not immediately report that he did not see the other person. When all of his forecasts were inevitably bad, Ticktock did not hesitate to report them even if they were not to the liking of his associates. Ticktock actively strove to be useful to his bosses, focusing to harness his powers as needed, even when several of his bosses (notably Dansen Macabre and Locksmith) were rude and critical of Ticktock. With his enemies, Ticktock sought to be intimidating (such as when he discouraged Locksmith's prisoners by anticipating their escape attempts, or when he kept Power Broker's minion in check by pointing a gun at them and anticipating possible escape attempts); even when outnumbered, Ticktock displayed admirable spunk, rising to distract the Avengers when they had his group defeated in order to give Shroud a chance to rescue them. That attitude didn't always work, as demonstrated when he tried to convince Moon Knight to accompany Night Shift instead of fighting. When arrested by the police in Los Angeles, Ticktock pretended to know nothing of Night Shift and kept his cool for as long as possible, hoping his employer would bail him out by sending a lawyer (though Detective Paul Hall nearly broke him by offering him freedom in exchange for betraying his boss); and his attempts to negotiate from a position of submission were unsuccessful after failing Count Nefaria. Ticktock enjoyed using his powers of predicting the future, and did so even when there was no need. He enjoyed telling his partners "I told you so," even when they might find it infuriating (Ironically, Ticktock did not pay much attention to the use of his powers, only to their results, and when his powers were enhanced by Satannish, he himself wanted to learn about it but it was other colleagues who observed the details of its use). Ticktock had a certain capacity for sarcasm which he sometimes used to quietly criticize his companions in good-natured barbs, especially Misfit, who also insulted Ticktock for being overweight. Ticktock seemed to be more intelligent and cultured than many of his companions, and was willing to listen even to his enemies when they presented valid arguments. However, he was perceived as creepy, and admittedly his priorities were peculiar, such as the fact that he did not perceive Locksmith as a dangerous madman.

fields.notes: Ticktock's profile in says that his power works only 10 seconds in the future; but and Ticktock's profile in confirm that it works 60 seconds in the future. The Hangman's profiles in both and say that the Locksmith "was determined to imprison all superhuman beings in Los Angeles"; the Night Shift's profile in expands this to the Los Angeles area. Night Shift's profile in also mentions how he captured "local superhumans". However, Spider-Woman and several of her allies were active in San Francisco, not in Los Angeles, at that time. Besides, in , the Locksmith explicitly targets the Viper while she was in Hartsdale, Illinois, as detailed in a footnote that references Viper's appearance in . considers Ticktock and others "former members" of Night Shift; but they were full members at that time. In , Ticktock mentions how he met Moon Knight when the latter was in the West Coast Avengers, possibly referencing , an issue in which both Ticktock and Moon Knight appear - but they do not share any scene. They had met when Moon Knight operated solo in . Although the Needle and Ticktock have not been seen again after their incineration, their other three allies who died have since reappeared (Dansen Macabre in and ; the Digger in and ; and Tatterdemalion in and ); the resurrections of these characters have not been explained.

tiger duncan.name: Tiger Duncan
tiger duncan.origin: thumb|left|133px|"Tiger" Duncan before his execution "Tiger" Duncan was a criminal who was active during the 1940's. Arrested he was found guilty of his crimes and was sentenced to death row. He attempted to break out of prison in 1944 when he obtained parts smuggled into the prison to assemble a gun. However, his planned escape was told to Captain America and Bucky by a local stool pigeon, and they thwarted his escape. Recaptured, Duncan vowed revenge against those who sent him to prison, and he was executed on the electric chair shortly thereafter. His body was taken to the prison infirmary where an autopsy was performed by the prison doctor. To the doctor's surprise, not only was Duncan's brain alive and well, but it had gained telepathic abilities and exerted its will over his body. Duncan then had the doctor put his brain in a jar of preservatives and sent the doctor to murder the men responsible for sending him to death row. The first was the District Attorney who help put Duncan away. The doctor was forced to shoot him while he was on the phone with the warden to learn of Duncan's execution. Duncan proclaimed his revenge using his own voice through the doctor's mouth. This was heard by the warden who recognized the voice as Duncan's and called in Captain America and Bucky to investigate the possibility that Duncan may have survived his execution. thumb|163px|The doctor possessed by Tiger Duncan While Cap and Bucky exhumed Duncan's body, the doctor was forced to strangle the judge who was responsible for sentencing Duncan to death. During the struggle, the doctor dropped a thermometer at the scene. Then the doctor was sent to murder the warden but was stopped by Captain America and Bucky who had pieced together the clues and deduced who the killer was. Knocking out the doctor, Captain America was shocked to find that his face was slowly starting to change to resemble that of Duncan's. The doctor then quickly revived and catching the two heroes off guard fled the scene. However, Cap and Bucky followed after the doctor to his home. There Duncan commanded the doctor to shoot Captain America, however Cap threw off the doctor's aim, causing the bullet to strike the jar containing Duncan's brain instead. With the death of Duncan's brain, its hold on the doctor was released. However, it also caused the doctor to begin to die as well, but he was happy to finally be free of Duncan's control and died in peace.
weaknesses: As a disembodied brain, Tiger Duncan was incapable of independent movement or communication and relied on others to do things for him.

tiger of tokchon.name: Tiger of Tokchon
tiger of tokchon.origin: The man who was known as the Tiger of Tokchon was a ruthless commanding officer in the People's Liberation Army of China during the 1950s. He was active during the Korean War, bringing his own daughter along with him, unaware that she was against his ruthless ways. During the course of the war he managed to capture American soldiers Hank "Combat" Kelly and Cookie Novak. Deciding to torture the two Americans, he had them buried up to their necks in mud and had their heads smeared with chocolate and left them to be eaten alive by ants. He then left the two soldiers to die to oversee his troops rig a path with explosives as a trap for an American troop that was scheduled to pass through the area. This proved to be the Tiger's undoing, as his daughter rescued Combat and Cookie, who then went after the Tiger. Before they could attack the enemy commander, the Tiger's own daughter mowed him down with a gun and then set off the explosives before the Chinese soldiers could get clear of their trap, decimating the entire enemy troop. Although she knew killing her father was the right thing to do, the girl still mourned his death.
weapons: The Tiger of Tokchon had weapons that were used by the People's Liberation Army during the Korean War at his disposal, but favored using a large sword.

tiger snake.name: Tiger Snake
tiger snake.origin: Tiger Snake was a member of the Serpent Society personally recruited by Pit Viper with the precise scope to steal ingredients to construct the Serpent's Tears, a Mephisto-related artifact. Unlike the rest of the Serpent Society, he was a firm believer of Mephisto, as he believed the demon saved his life. After being tipped off by Pit Viper, Tiger Snake ambushed Avengers Emergency Response Squad member Shang-Chi in Germany while the Master of Kung Fu was investigating the theft Tiger Snake committed earlier. After a brief fight, Tiger Snake poisoned Shang-Chi with his powers, forcing Shang-Chi to use his Ten Rings to knock Tiger Snake back and teleport away to heal. Back at the Serpent Stronghold, Tiger Snake informed the rest of the Society that the AVENG.E.R.S. now knew of their activities, which angered several of them, but he and Pit Viper reaffirmed the potential success of the Serpent's Tears. For the Serpent Society's final heist at an abandoned mine in Attania, Tiger Snake led a decoy team to keep the AVENG.E.R.S (consisting of Captain America, Shang-Chi, Lightspeed, Night Thrasher, Wasp and Hawkeye) preoccupied while Pit Viper and Titanoboa gathered the final component for the Serpent's Tears. Tiger Snake feigned defeat, allowing Titanoboa take the AVENGE.R.S. by surprise and incapacitate them while Pit Viper completed the Serpent's Tears. Tiger Snake watched on when Pit Viper subjected Captain America to the Serpent's Tears, which turned him into a snake-like monster. However, when the remaining AVENG.E.R.S (Photon, Lightning, Wonder Man, She-Hulk and Hercules) arrived as reinforcements, Tiger Snake was defeated by Shang-Chi while the rest of the Serpents were routed and the supply Serpent Tears was destroyed. Tiger Snake and the other Serpents were sent to the Hague to be tried for their crimes.
powers: Poison Generation: Tiger Snake can generate a deadly poison from his hands that is lethal to anyone who comes into contact with it.
abilities: Master Martial Artist

After a brief fight, Tiger Snake poisoned Shang-Chi with his powers, forcing Shang-Chi to use his Ten Rings to knock Tiger Snake back and teleport away to heal. Back at the Serpent Stronghold, Tiger Snake informed the rest of the Society that the AVENG.E.R.S. now knew of their activities, which angered several of them, but he and Pit Viper reaffirmed the potential success of the Serpent's Tears. For the Serpent Society's final heist at an abandoned mine in Attania, Tiger Snake led a decoy team to keep the AVENG.E.R.S (consisting of Captain America, Shang-Chi, Lightspeed, Night Thrasher, Wasp and Hawkeye) preoccupied while Pit Viper and Titanoboa gathered the final component for the Serpent's Tears. Tiger Snake feigned defeat, allowing Titanoboa take the AVENGE.R.S. by surprise and incapacitate them while Pit Viper completed the Serpent's Tears. Tiger Snake watched on when Pit Viper subjected Captain America to the Serpent's Tears, which turned him into a snake-like monster. However, when the remaining AVENG.E.R.S (Photon, Lightning, Wonder Man, She-Hulk and Hercules) arrived as reinforcements, Tiger Snake was defeated by Shang-Chi while the rest of the Serpents were routed and the supply Serpent Tears was destroyed. Tiger Snake and the other Serpents were sent to the Hague to be tried for their crimes.

tigerman.name: Tigerman
tigerman.origin: The origin of the jungle hero known as Tigerman is unrevealed. He befriended an ape named Rangoo that would become his faithful companion. One day in the jungles he came across explorer Professor Carson and his daughter Louise Carson who were attacked by members of the Monolink Tribe. Although Tigerman came to their aid, they were all captured and brought to the Monolink Tribe's leader King Kuu. Kuu had them locked away in a prison, however Tigerman and Rangoo helped the Carson's break free. Escaping in one of King Kuu's advanced boats, they attempted to escape down a river, however, the tribes weapons damaged the boat, causing it to sink. While they managed to get away from the Monolink Tribe by swimming down the rapids, Professor Carson drowned. With her father's death, Louise wished to remain with Tigerman. Their subsequent activities remain unrevealed.

tike alicar.name: Tike Alicar
tike alicar.origin: Tike Alicar was raised by Caucasian foster parents in the northern Midwest, but eventually he started to wonder why his skin was darker than theirs, so he began compulsively washing his hands to clean the "dirt" off. In this way he discovered his Mutant ability. His sweat is acidic, and allows him to generate energy of an unknown type. By the time he was an adult, he had created a fiercely African-American militant persona. He used this persona when applying for a position in the pop-culture mutant team X-Statix (then called X-Force). He joined the team when one of its founding members was replaced after being killed in action. Alicar used his race and genetic edge to play his teammates against each other to help get the headlines and camera turned in his direction, becoming one of the more argumentative and divisive members of the team. At the same time, Alicar took care to keep the secret of the origins of his family and his obsessive-compulsive disorder, fearing that his standing on the highly-publicized team would be compromised. During his time with X-Statix, Alicar had formed a relationship with Dead Girl after she saved his life on a mission. When yet another dispute over leadership and membership elections arose between Alicar and his teammate Orphan, Alicar left X-Statix with Dead Girl. Together, the two gathered more headlines touring as the Death & Anarchy Roadshow. However, Orphan later embarked on a highly dangerous mission by himself, and Alicar and Dead Girl rejoined the team to help him defeat the powerful mutant Arnie Lunt. The team was not prepared when the Orphan forced the team to accept Fanboy as a new member. In reality, the Orphan arranged events so that Fanboy's weak heart would give out during a mission, surreptitiously planning his murder. Frustrated with himself and with the team, the Orphan quit X-Statix. Shortly afterward, a criminal calling himself Bad Guy began terrorizing America. Believing Bad Guy to be the Orphan, unhinged, X-Statix publicly denounced Bad Guy, named the Anarchist as X-Statix' leader, and devoted their activities to defeating the villain. In fact, Bad Guy was a creature from a pocket dimension visited by X-Statix' Venus Dee Milo, taking the form of Dee Milo's fears. The Orphan reappeared to help X-Statix defeat Bad Guy, and he rejoined the team while accepting the Alicar as the new leader. When X-Statix was forced to accept the pop sensation Henrietta Hunter into their ranks, Alicar was among those who were incensed with the situation. He was especially upset with the public pressure to make Henrietta the team's leader. With the Orphan's suggestion, he allowed Henrietta to be named leader, knowing that she would grow disgusted with X-Statix' milieu or die in the battlefield. Henrietta's European enemies decided to launch their next attack against X-Statix as a whole: leaking information that detailed how X-Statix' owner, Spike Freeman, and U-Go Girl sold weapons of mass destruction to Saddam Hussein. X-Statix's public image was destroyed. The only way to repair their image was to take down Mister Code once and for all, and Alicar helped in defeating the villain. Although X-Statix remained in the public eye for several months, things were never the same, especially since their prime source of financial backing, Spike Freeman, was dead. During the night of their farewell party, X-Statix agreed to take on one more mission, as it promised to be high-paying and low-risk. Alicar fought against going, because he noticed a change in Dead Girl's condition. However, he agreed with the majority. When the mission turned sour, the ranks of X-Statix were decimated. Alicar was presumably killed alongside the Orphan, making a final stand against the villains. Tike was recently resurrected to serve Pitiful One. He later became a citizen of the mutant-only nation of Krakoa.
weaknesses: He suffered from obsessive compulsive disorder, which made him obsessed with being clean by washing his hands repeatedly.

tikos.name: Tikos
tikos.origin: Tikos was a minor member of the household guard who served Prince Gareth, the uncle of Emperor Jason. Stationed in Gareth's private wing of the Imperial Chalet, located on the continent of Marathon on the Imperial Throneworld Sparta, Tikos served as the jailor and interrogator of any prisoners that the prince chose to secretly imprison there. After Star-Lord's starship went down in flames over Thrace, a lifeboat that had been shot free before impact was found by Gareth's household guard and its two occupants, Kip Hölm and Sandy, were captured and secretly brought to the chalet where they were imprisoned. Once there, Tikos began interrogating Kip for information, beating and whipping him while Sandy was forced to watch. However, Kip withstood the physical abuse and refused to talk. Eventually, Arion, one of Gareth's higher-ranked minions, intervened. After calling Tikos a brute and pointing out that he'd discovered nothing in the three days he'd had the boy, Arion took over the interrogation. Explaining that the mind-ripper that was being brought from Kandahar would tear Kip's secrets from him but the resistance of the captives should be broken down first and with finesse, Arion prepared to use blades to torture Sandy who had killed his twin days earlier. Before he could begin, Arion was shocked when the supposedly-dead Star-Lord made his presence in the room known. Tikos reacted first, lunging at Star-Lord with a metal staff in his hands while saying, "Milord Arion, I'll..." but his words were cut short by a grunt of pain when Star-Lord delivered a powerful punch that knocked him out. Kip took advantage of this distraction to wrap his legs around Arion's neck and twist, snapping Arion's neck and killing him. Star-Lord then freed his two young allies and all three left the chamber of horrors, unaware that these events had been watched from above by an Anubian hidden in the shadows of an upper gallery.

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.origin: The man only known for his sobriquet, Tilt, grew up in horrible circumstances. He experimented first with tagging, skating, and playing in a punk band before settling on body art and piercing. He opened his own tattoo and piercing shop, and while he got a reputation as a tattoo artist, his true passion was piercing. Tilt's fame was extended further by a reality television show and he became rich. He used his money to fulfill his fantasy to pierce people to death. Over the years, he perfected this type of torture, and this hobby earned him entrance to the selective underground Société des Sadiques. The Société's biannual feast for new inductees was interrupted when Moon Knight revealed himself to have infiltrated the inner circle to hunt down the cult's leader Ernst. Moon Knight and the other inductees took part in four individual trials before fighting each other. For the fifth trial, Moon Knight brutally and effortlessly beat down the other contestants, including Tilt.

Frustrated by his lack of success in the dating world, he visited a magic shop and purchased a strength potion for fifty cents. The eccentric proprietor offered him an antidote, but it cost $100 and Tim reasoned that he'd never need it anyway. The potion turned Tim into a well-muscled man. However, he also gained a harsher more aggressive personality and beat up his rivals and bullied women into dating him. That night, he awoke from bed and learned why he should have bought the antidote, as he quickly grew so dense that the Earth couldn't hold his weight and he plummeted down into the planet's core.

tim gilliam.first_appearance: Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers Season 1 1
tim gilliam.origin: Tim Gilliam is the leader of the Celebrity Five, five human criminals that work directly for Loki Laufeyson. In his daily life he was an employee of S.H.I.E.L.D. before revealing his true colors. Tim Gilliam was one of the Celebrity Five members that helped Loki during his attack on the Raft. He helped release the various supervillains from their cells so they could attack the Avengers. He also smuggled some villains on board the Helicarrier to keep S.H.I.E.L.D. busy. When Akira and Hikaru tried to reach the heliport with the last Biocode Installer, Tim and M.O.D.O.K. intercepted them. Tim ordered M.O.D.O.K. to destroy the installer, but could not prevent the installer from giving the two boys and their 3 friends a biocode. He and Loki had to retreat when Akira used his new biocode to D-smash Iron Man, and accidently caused the other DISKs to get scattered across the globe. From then on, Tim became a recurring opponent for the Avengers and their young partners. He also began his attempts to replace magic with technology, starting by building a teleportation device for instant travel between Loki's ice palace and every other location. As the scientist of the team, he was also responsible for assiting Dr. Akatsuki in building the Power Transfer device which Loki intended to use to transfer the powers of all heroes and villians in the DISKs to himself. Tim managed to work out all the bugs Dr. Akatsuki put in the machine to stall time, and even mocked Akatsuki for thinking he wouldn't notice. When Loki was initially defeated in the battle at his Ice Palace, and banished to the Dark Dimension, the Celebrity Five were arrested. Tim didn't mind, and thought that they could easily strike a bargain with S.H.I.E.L.D. since they still had their biocodes. The team was broken out of prison transport by Crossbones, who proceeded to steal their Biocodes and then forcefully drafted them in to Hydra. Like his fellow Celebrity Five members, Tim hated being a Hydra soldier, considering it a disgrace that a scientist like him was forced to do manual labour. Tim was ordered to help Abomination guard one of the 5 Gaia Anchors with which Red Skull intended to destroy the world. When Edward Grant and Hulk come to the Raft to destroy the Anchor, the Celebrity Five actually helped them accomplish this goal since they wanted to see Red Skull fail. When Red Skull was likewise defeated and Hydra dissolved, Tim and the other Celebrity Five became fugitives. With their reputations destroyed, they visited their old lair to salvage whatever valuables they could find. It was here that Loki contacted the group again from the other dimension he had been banished to. He restored their biocodes and ordered them to prepare forh is return, starting with an attack on a security conference. Presumably to steal the passwords for all security systems of the countries represented at the conference. Tim was the only one of the Celebrity Five to which Loki told the true reason for this attack; lure the Avengers out, and use a special energy storing device to absorb an attack from Iron Mans' Build Up Armor. When Loki's new henchman Ronin arrived from the Dark Dimension, he usurped Tim as leader of the Celebrity Five and led them in a mission to steal the Treasures of Darkenss for Loki, which he needed to powerup a machine called the Dark Gate device and open an even greater portal to the Dark Dimension in order to release Dormammu. Tim accompanied Ronin to Loki's old Ice Palace to retrieve a computerchip that was left there, which they succeeded in taking despite the Avengers interference. They also succeed in stealing all the Treasures of Darkness. When the Avengers and their partners discovered Loki's true plan and came to destroy the Dark Gate device, Tim and Joel confronted the group with their latest villains, Bi-Beast and Iron Monger. Both villains were defeated, but the Avengers could not prevent Ronin from opening the portal. However, once the portal was opened, it became clear that Dormammu and Loki had no intention of giving Tim and the other Celebrity Five members a role in their conquest of Earth, and Dormammu dragged Tim into the Dark Dimension. After both Loki and Dormammu are defeated, Tim and the other Celebrity Five members somehow escape the Dark Dimension again, and at the end of the series they are still at large. How they escaped remains unknown, but it is suggested Loki had something to do with it.
powers: Tim Gilliam has a Tech Biocode installed in his body, allowing him to D-Smash Tech-Class villains from their DISKs as well as D-Secure them back into their DISKs.

tim kelliher.name: Tim Kelliher
tim kelliher.origin: Morning Bugle editor Tim Kelliher received a distress signal on the teletype and sent his reporter Fred Byron to rescue them and get the scoop. Fred reluctantly went out into the blizzard and saved a group of people, but they were not the ones who sent the distress signal. Back at the newsroom, the same thing happened three more times, with Kelliher encouraging Fred with money and fame, and Fred braving the weather to save more people who were not the ones sending the distress signal on the teletype. When Fred finally decided not to risk the rescue attempt, Kelliher told him that there was no need as the signal was no longer coming, not knowing that the signal was coming from the Moon, which they were reporting to their rescue team.

tim rhodes.name: Tim Rhodes
tim rhodes.origin: Tim Rhodes was a mutant who came to Stony Plain, Alberta claiming to only be looking to make new friends. His appearance and abilities forced the police to treat him as a threat. Coincidentally Charles Xavier and Namor happened to be in town following rumors of a possible mutant. When Tim "made friends" with an officer, the others began to shoot at him; meanwhile, the officer struck by Tim's powers had had his DNA transumted into that of a human-animal hybrid. Charles prevented the RCMP from shooting at them as he conducted a psychic sweep of Tim's mind and found out that he was part of a government program which labeled him as subject Genus. Tim had escaped from a facility and began transforming animals into people in hopes that they could help him. Xavier saw the transformation of the cop and realized that Tim could change the species of any living creature, meaning they could use Tim's gift to accelerate mankind's evolution into mutants; however, Namor saw that Tim's powers would be used by humans as a cure for mutation instead and forcibly attempted to convince Xavier of this. Xavier lost control of one of the officers, who fired a shell from a shotgun into Tim's chest. As he lay dying in the streets he whispered to Namor that he was lonely.

tim skelly.name: Tim Skelly
tim skelly.origin: Big Tim Skelly was a crimelord who controlled Newton City, Delaware, since approximately 1916 to World War II, controlling the politicians, deciding who thrived, and being a virtual dictator of the city. By early 1941, Skelly had also made a secret deal with Heinie Myers, czar of the city's underworld, although Skelly was wary to be ever visited by Myers (apparently because Myers was a known lawbreaker while Skelly, who control the politics in the city, had to keep up a charade of respectability). thumb|left|Big Tim Skelly In 1941, Tom Douglas became the District Attorney, with Skelly's support, but Douglas was proactive against organized crime. Douglas suspected of the deal between Myers and Skelly, or at least Myers believed that, so Myers went to see Skelly in person, against Skelly's wishes, to demand Skelly to control Douglas. While angry at Myers' untimely visit, Skelly did as Myers had asked: Skelly sent hired killers to murder Douglas' political rival Daniel "Dan" Reardon, leaving behind proof that would incriminate Douglas. Douglas was arrested, and Skelly intended to push buttons so that Douglas would be sentenced to death. However, superhuman adventurer the Vision, believing in Douglas' innocence, tracked Skelly's goons and had them confess and incriminate Skelly. The Vision then went after Skelly, who at that point was celebrating with Myers: The Vision told them what he had achieved, then grabbed Myers, who asked Skelly for help before being knocked down. Skelly grabbed a gun and shot Vision, but instead hit Myers dead. The ruckus attracted the police, who immediately arrested Skelly for Myers' homicide because the Vision used his powers to vanish before the policemen could see him. Skelly was then charged with Reardon's death too, and his control over Newton City ended. Douglas was exonerated and thus, with Vision help, he unseat Skelly.
weapons: Skelly was armed with a pistol.

timara.name: Timara
timara.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Timara was a dancing girl in the Thieves' Quarter of Shadizar the Wicked, Zamora, around her twenties. She was nevertheless known of higher people, and traders, priests, and even a king or two came to see her dance. Eventually, the wanderlust seized her and she joined a traveling carnival troupe that zigzagged back and forth along the border of Zamora, Corinthia and Koth. One night, the troupe camped near pre-human ruins atop Dagoth Hill, in Dark Valley. Unlike her companions, Timara reveled the strangeness of the place and went to dance madly in the ruins, until she fell asleep, exhausted. She awoke as the Demon of Dark Valley was mating with her. Twin sons were born of that union: Tsotha-Lanti was sent away with Druids, while she lived with Laza-Lanti in the Dark Valley until he left the Valley when about ten years old . She then rejoined the Demon of Dark Valley. There, she collected the cattle sacrificed by the people of Dark Valley to the Demon-Lord. ===Laza-Lanti's return=== Ten years later, Laza-Lanti returned with an ally, Conan the Cimmerian, and followed her as she led the cattle to the Demon of Dark Valley. Discovering it, Laza-Lanti attacked the monster and managed to kill it. Timara revealed the truth to Laza-Lanti, then committed suicide laying on the carcass of her lover to join the Demon a last time, in death. Shocked, Laza-Lanti committed suicide at his turn.
powers: Timara kept her youth thanks to a spell from the Demon of Dark Valley, until he died.

Roy Thomas decided to flesh out the character. In the short story, the sorcerer Pelias (Tsotha-Lanti's archenemy) mention's his foe's origin: "As for Tsotha—men say that a dancing­-girl of Shadizar slept too near the pre-human ruins on Dagoth Hill and woke in the grip of a black demon; from that unholy union was spawned an accursed hybrid men call Tsotha-lanti—"

time bot.name: Time-bot
time bot.origin: Doctor Doom built and activated this robot as a part of a plan to get Thor's hammer Mjolnir and use it to power another machine, the Time Displacer, to raid Castle Doom, then occupied by usurper Kristoff Vernard. Doom studied Thor's psychology and knew that Thor kept an eye on criminals he had personally captured; so he sent the Timebot to rescue some crooks from the police station. The robot broke the building's wall and shot policemen Vinnie Evans and Marcus Stone, sending the former to the past for a few seconds; Evans returned in shock. Further policemen came to attack the intruder, but were unable to stop the robot. When the journalists reported the event, it came to Thor's attention; Thor went to station with his ally Hercules. Doom monitored the fray and, when he saw the unexpected presence of Hercules, he decided to go there personally, joining the Timebot's side. When Doom came, the robot went to his side, and Hercules and Thor followed them, while the policemen re-captured the fugitives. Thor then hurled his hammer to the robot's chest plate, its apparent vulnerability, but the robot shot its ray and captured the hammer in the timestream. Doom and the Timebot left, having stolen the hammer. Doom and the robot went to Latveria in a vehicle with a crew of Defense Droids. Once there, Doom ordered his robots to build the Time Displacer machine, and the Timebot to leave Thor's hammer within the machine. Using the hammer's mystic energies, Doom stopped movement within the city and castle, except for people with immunity such as his robots and himself. Doom left for the castle, leaving the Defense Droids and the Timebot to protect the machine. Tracking the stolen weapon, Hercules went to Latveria along with his allies She-Hulk and architect Eric Masterson -secretly Thor's human identity at that point, who would become Thor again as soon as he could grab the hammer. The three heroes found the Time Displacer and confronted the robots there. When Masterson saw Mjolnir, he tried to grab it but was intercepted by the Timebot. Masterson pole-vaulted over the robot to grab the hammer, causing the machine to blow up, and the explosion destroyed the robot - Masterson himself survived by becoming Thor. As far as known, Doctor Doom never built another working unit of the Timebot before or after the destruction of the first one.
powers: it is unclear if the robot can send target to any other moment. The robot can also store an inanimate item indefinitely in the time stream. Video streaming: The timebot's eye report anything it sees to Doom's monitors.
weaknesses: The robot cannot speak. It has limited initiative and autonomy, only following Doom's orders.

Thor then hurled his hammer to the robot's chest plate, its apparent vulnerability, but the robot shot its ray and captured the hammer in the timestream. Doom and the Timebot left, having stolen the hammer. Doom and the robot went to Latveria in a vehicle with a crew of Defense Droids. Once there, Doom ordered his robots to build the Time Displacer machine, and the Timebot to leave Thor's hammer within the machine. Using the hammer's mystic energies, Doom stopped movement within the city and castle, except for people with immunity such as his robots and himself. Doom left for the castle, leaving the Defense Droids and the Timebot to protect the machine. Tracking the stolen weapon, Hercules went to Latveria along with his allies She-Hulk and architect Eric Masterson -secretly Thor's human identity at that point, who would become Thor again as soon as he could grab the hammer. The three heroes found the Time Displacer and confronted the robots there. When Masterson saw Mjolnir, he tried to grab it but was intercepted by the Timebot. Masterson pole-vaulted over the robot to grab the hammer, causing the machine to blow up, and the explosion destroyed the robot - Masterson himself survived by becoming Thor. As far as known, Doctor Doom never built another working unit of the Timebot before or after the destruction of the first one.
powers: it is unclear if the robot can send target to any other moment. The robot can also store an inanimate item indefinitely in the time stream. Video streaming: The timebot's eye report anything it sees to Doom's monitors.
weaknesses: The robot cannot speak. It has limited initiative and autonomy, only following Doom's orders.

time buoy number 6 c.name: Time-Buoy Number 6-C
time buoy number 6 c.origin: The Tribunals were beings who considered themselves to be the antibodies of the universe. They needed to gather information on the Defenders, so they created a robot for that purpose. It was programmed with a human, feminine personality, and granted false memories. Under the identity of Luann Bloom, the robot was intended to become a companion for Nighthawk. Luann was unaware of her own status as a sleeper agent. Nighthawk was paralyzed during the daytime hours, while his powers restored his mobility during the night. Luann was hired as Nighthawk's personal nurse. She picked up her new patient from the residence of Doctor Strange. Nighthawk and Luann got properly acquainted through an hours-long conversation. Nighthawk considered her a friend. Luann was surprised when her patient vanished from a closed room, thanks to Hellcat's Shadow Cloak. Luann silently watched as several members of the Defenders chose to leave the team. She was only there to offer a ride home to Nighthawk. While Clea tried to find a mystic cure for Nighthawk's paralysis, Luann waited nearby with Wong. She later accompanied Nighthawk while he visited his ex-girlfriend Mindy Williams at a mental institution. Nighthawk got furious with August Masters' plans, and Luann tried to calm him down. Nighthawk had a meeting with his lawyers Matt Murdock and Milton Rosenblum. They discussed the legal charges against Nighthawk, while Luann acted mostly as a silent witness in the meeting. They were all shocked when the charges were suddenly dropped. August Masters claimed to have arranged for this development. Nighthawk arranged a party for the apparent end to his legal troubles. Luann attended the party, along with Murdock, Rosenblum, and some of the current members of the Defenders. Enemy agents entered interrupted the festivities, knocking everyone out with gas. They kidnapped the Defenders, with Luann unable to help her patient. Summoned by Milton Rosenblum, Luan was informed that Nighthawk was dead. The information was based on reports by S.H.I.E.L.D.. Luan was horrified and left in tears. However, she had lingering doubts about her patient's death. She vowed to find out the true circumstances of that death. Luann received a phone call from an apparent representative of S.H.I.E.L.D. He asked her to meet him on a certain street corner. The meeting was a ruse. When Luann arrived at the meeting place, she found one of the Elves with Guns waiting for her. He was there to kidnap her. Luann boarded a car with the Elf. She was surprised when the car transported them through several different dimensions of the universe. Luann did not feel afraid through their journey. But when she met one of the Tribunals and she was asked to report to him, she was confused. She had no idea who he was and what he wanted from her. The Tribunal briefly explained her status as a sleeper agent to her, but she denied it. In response, the Elf ripped off her faceplate and revealed the circuitry beneath it. Her programming took over, and Luann started narrating several stories which Nighthawk had shared with her. She even included a previously unrecorded battle between the Defenders and Yandroth. After listening to her report, the Tribunal left her inert. She was intended for transport to a storage unit. The Elf captured and transported four members of the Defenders (Doctor Strange, Hulk, Silver Surfer, and Sub-Mariner). They passed through Luann's inert form with no incident. Shortly later, Luann re-activated herself. She was angry, and she started verbally attacking the Tribunal. Another Elf with a Gun shut her down. The Defenders were informed that Luann was a robot, but Luann still considered herself to be human. The Tribunal considered her defective and ordered her destruction. One of the Elves started pulling her inert form towards a scrap heap. Her ultimate fate remains unrevealed.

timeslot.name: Timeslot
timeslot.origin: Timeslot was a mercenary from the Death Sponsors. They were hired to find and bring back Arize who excaped from the Mojoworld. Timeslot teleported the team to the Earth, but they ended up in Tokyo, Japan. Deadair tracked down Arize, and they teleported again directly to the X-Mansion. While his teammates were fighting with the X-Men, Timeslot managed to capture Arize. Bishop had managed to sever the link between Arize and Timeslot just as he was preparing to teleport with the team back to Mojoworld, so then the next moment they teleported away, Arize had stayed behind. Years later the Death Sponsors were hired by Gringrave, an old gladiator partner of Shatterstar. They kidnapped Shatterstar's tenants and teleported them to Mojoworld, but one of them, an elderly Dwayne Taylor from Earth-90214 had taken Timeslot by surprise and managed to stab him in the neck with a knife.

timmy glenn.name: Timmy Glenn
timmy glenn.origin: Corkscrew participated in a try-out held by X-Statix to find a replacement member for the recently deceased U-Go Girl, at the Nevada X-Statix Training Camp. He was a promising candidate, 'a rising star in the feeder leagues', and had a rep for going in where it hurt. He was qualified as a "Code X", which meant that his mutation had possibly driven him insane, and expressed extreme violence during training. He was seen kicking a green-skinned man but then used his powers to kill an opponent moments later during a session in front of the X-Statix. His case was handled by Doop as X-Statix owner Spike Freeman wanted to determine his real status. The mutant Corkscrew killed would have his death explained in a different way, as deaths during training are not popular with the public, so it would be said the mutant had died during a mission. Doop took Corkscrew out into the woods for what Corkscrew thought was a final test for X-Statix. Doop had the man filmed and his mood ranged from cheery and upbeat, to a horse-butchering, sobbing breakdown. At which point, Doop ended the man's misery, killing him with an axe and a smile.
powers: Corkscrew is a mutant who can turn his forearms (and possibly other sections of his body) into hard, sharp tendrils. : Corkscrew tended to spin around in a 'corkscrew' motion to drill at his enemies.
weaknesses: Insanity: His powers had given him a kind of bipolarity and rendered him extremely violent, classifying him as Code-X.

timothy inferno baby.name: Timothy (Inferno Baby)
timothy inferno baby.origin: ===Inferno Babies=== Timmy was the child of a stock broker, Tim, and his wife, Helen, living outside of the city of New York. Using information from Cameron Hodge, thirteen mutant children (including Timmy) were kidnapped by N'astirh's N'asteris, during the Inferno. The infants arrived in a cemetery, where the demon N'astirh was attempting to create a permanent portal open between the demon infested dimension of Limbo and Earth. The infants were teleported to Times Square, where the New Mutant, Magik, was opening a portal to return her teammates from Limbo and N'astirh, using 10 of the babies as the points of an inverted pentagram (focusing beams of power because of their purity and openness to use them as natural, living conduits who could not block the flow of power and who would not know how to shut it off), kept the portal open. N'astirh attempted to used them, and baby Christopher Summers, who later grew-up to become Cable, to open a portal from Limbo to Earth and was partially successful in merging the two realms. The X-Terminators and the New Mutants rescued the babies from the pentacle. After the defeat of N'astirh, the Goblin Queen attempted to sacrifice baby Christopher and the other three mutant babies atop the Empire State Building to finish N'astirh's work and permanently open a gateway between Earth and Limbo. The invasion was thwarted after the Goblin Queen committed suicide in combat with Marvel Girl, attempting to kill everyone in her power. After the X-Terminators and New Mutants took the babies to X-Factor's Celestial Ship, X-Factor turned the babies over to the US government, while being attacked by Nanny and Orphan-Maker. ===Project Purgatory=== For many years the fate of children remained unknown. Following the Inferno, the United States Army founded Project Purgatory to research the fields of the supernatural and paranormal. One of the recruited scientists, Doctor Noc, developed technology to use the children to open portals to Limbo. General Ulysses, Doctor Noc, and a trained band of military soldiers established a military base in Limbo, the Hatchery. At the base, they continued to experiment, both on demons and on the Inferno babies, and train new soldiers. However, when the soldiers recovered the Bloodstone amulet, the base was attacked by Witchfire and the Inferno babies were believed dead. The Earth based military forces sealed off the portal Epsilon, leaving those on the Limbo base stranded to find the observation portal with virtually no hope of escape. After 26 years in Limbo, but only 4 years on Earth, Noc and Ulysses were able to locate a traveling portal and return home, keeping the existence of the children to themselves. However, they never gave up their mission of taking control of Limbo and capturing Illyana Rasputin. They returned to a world where all of the mutants were living together, on Utopia. and, therefore, their commanding officer, General Combest, ordered them to stand-down. The unit still believed that Illyana was a significant threat and, after Project Purgatory kidnapped Pixie, the Inferno Babies revealed themselves when they killed General Combest and obliterated the entire battalion. The New Mutants showed to rescue Pixie and the Inferno Babies defeated them. After Dr. Noc and General Ulysses took Illyana's Soulsword and Pixie's Souldagger, they extracted the Bloodstones and completed the Bloodstone Amulet to call forth the Elder Gods. They, along with members of Project Purgatory, tortured the New Mutants. While attempting to transport the New Mutants to Limbo, to be used as sacrifices for the Elder Gods, Karma showed Face what Project Purgatory had done to him and he killed Timothy, Maw, and members of Project Purgatory and freed Magik and Karma.
powers: He can generate some type of energy from organic exhausts on his forearms. : He can use this energy to propel himself through the air, like a rocket.

timothy anders.name: Timothy Anders
timothy anders.origin: Timothy Anders was the son of a homeless alcoholic woman named Gretl Anders. During a blizzard, Gretl with the assistance of fellow alcoholic Tony Stark gave birth to her son in New York City. Shortly after holding him for the first time, Gretl perished, leaving the child in the care of Stark. They were eventually found by rescue workers who took both of them to a hospital. The newborn child was then sent to an orphanage in Bowery where he was given the name Timothy by the nuns. As part of his plan to strike back against Stark, Obadiah Stane had minions kidnap Timothy, alongside other people close to Stark. Stark tried to prevent the kidnapping, but because he didn't have access to his armor, there was little he could do to stop it. Taken to the headquarters of Stane International, Timothy, Mrs. Arbogast, Happy Hogan and Pepper Potts were put in suspended animation cells which were rigged with circuits that could instantly kill anyone inside. Stark in his Silver Centurion Armor fought Stane in his own Iron Monger Armor, but as he was losing the battle, Stane brought to Stark to his captives and threatened him with Timothy's life. After getting his friends out of their cells, Stark took control of the Iron Monger's control unit, knocking Stane out and rescuing Timothy. Stark handed the infant to a nearby firefighter, telling him to take care of the child while he went back to fight Stane. Growing in the orphanage, Tim learned early on to protect himself and fight back against bullies. With a Stark scholarship, he enrolled in a prestigious school. One day, Tim noticed a group of kids beating a defenseless Normie Osborn and quickly intervened. Beating up the bullies, Tim helped Normie get back on his feet and gave him his uniform jacket since Normie's had been ruined. Befriending each other, Tim told Normie how bullies were like sharks which immediately attacked as soon as they smelled blood, giving Normie an idea to how to rescue his grandfather Norman, who had been kidnapped by the Goblin Nation. After Normie left to rescue his grandfather, Tim was interrogated by the principal over Normie's absence, but the boy attempted to cover it up in order to not get his new friend in trouble.

Growing in the orphanage, Tim learned early on to protect himself and fight back against bullies. With a Stark scholarship, he enrolled in a prestigious school. One day, Tim noticed a group of kids beating a defenseless Normie Osborn and quickly intervened. Beating up the bullies, Tim helped Normie get back on his feet and gave him his uniform jacket since Normie's had been ruined. Befriending each other, Tim told Normie how bullies were like sharks which immediately attacked as soon as they smelled blood, giving Normie an idea to how to rescue his grandfather Norman, who had been kidnapped by the Goblin Nation. After Normie left to rescue his grandfather, Tim was interrogated by the principal over Normie's absence, but the boy attempted to cover it up in order to not get his new friend in trouble.

timothy braverman.name: Timothy Braverman
timothy braverman.origin: According to his own words (which may have been false), Tim Braverman grew up in a poor family in Brooklyn with his younger brother. Their mother "worked for a living," possibly dishonorably, while their alcoholic father spent the money that came in and beat Braverman when he wasn't too drunk. Braverman and his younger brother learned to shoplift in order to obtain basic goods such as milk. They developed a ruse where the younger brother would attract the attention of the shopkeeper by pretending to steal, and when the keeper and the authorities were distracted by him, Tim Braverman himself would make off with the loot. However, on one such occasion, an inebriated off-duty policeman shot and killed Tim Braverman's brother, even though the shopkeeper would have forgiven him. Enraged, Tim Braverman vowed to stop being poor and ridiculing the authorities in order to avenge his brother. Braverman moved to the West Coast, where he spent years working, studying, planning and executing crimes, eventually becoming the criminal mastermind Gamesman, whom other criminals paid to plan their hits. From an underground sanctum called the Situation Room, the Gamesman met with his associates, always hiding his face behind a hood. The Gamesman obtained confidential information on locations to rob, from alarm systems to guard schedules, and sometimes even developed custom technology to carry out the hit. The Gamesman had also assembled an intricate network of criminal contacts to help him obtain illegal resources, such as fake IDs; and even had the Los Angeles Police Headquarters' cleaner, Marsha, on his payroll so that she'd phone in information she could overhear. Finally, the Gamesman had collected ten million dollars worth of stolen diamonds, which he stored in a safety deposit vault at Los Angeles Bank and Trust Company, but very few people knew about his "insurance". The Gamesman's hits had the Los Angeles Police Department baffled, and bounties began to be placed on the capture of the Gamesman and his associates, and for the return of the goods he'd stolen. The Gamesman carefully planned a robbery of modern art paintings at the Los Angeles County Art Museum for a client named Charlie, and as usual, the police had no leads: LAPD Jacobi put detectives Harris and Stevens on the case, and informed his boss, Captain Alexander Walsh. By then, superheroine Spider-Woman had just begun a career as a bounty hunter in Los Angeles with the help of criminologist Scotty McDowell, delivering caught criminals to Walsh. Immediately after apprehending serial murderer Killer Clown, Spider-Woman captured the museum thieves and, along with the stolen paintings, delivered them to Walsh in his office, neither of them knowing that Marsha was informing the Gamesman on this. The Gamesman, knowing that Spider-Woman had foiled his heist and might do it again, wanted to take action against her by pretending to be her friend: He sent five of his thugs, including Bonzo and Rufus to ambush her as she left the station through an alley, hoping that she would be overwhelmed by their sheer numbers, and then Braverman would appear, unmasked, to help her escape, his car ready, thus gaining her trust. Braverman made an excuse for being there, claiming to be a Los Angeles Times reporter lurking around the station looking for a scoop on the Gamesman; he then flattered her, claiming he recognized her by reputation, and even offered first aid for her work. Spider-Woman, reasonably suspicious, asked to be left on the ground, but Braverman still insisted on inviting her to a picnic the next day in the country. When Spider-Woman reported what happened to McDowell, he asked for more details, and she believed he was jealous (which he was). McDowell wanted Spider-Woman to look for more clues about the Gamesman, but she decided to go to rest, determined to keep the date with Braverman. Following this encounter, the Gamesman was able to inform his clients that he had already begun taking steps to ensure that Spider-Woman would not interfere with his plans again. His next plan was to rob the Rajah Ruby from an international gem exhibit at the Civic Auditorium for the benefit of a criminal group in Detroit, using a chemical foam specifically developed by the Gamesman himself to silence the alarms, and with his people ready to knock out the guards with gas guns. One of the Gamesman's men, Momo, spoke of this at a gangland nightclub, unaware that Spider-Woman was spying on him disguised as a waitress. During the picnic, Spider-Woman told Braverman about the tip about the Rajah Ruby theft. Braverman attempted to convince Spider-Woman not to go there, first suggesting that the Gamesman might have another plan, and then saying that it could be dangerous. He then kissed her, beginning a romantic relationship. Infatuated, Spider-Woman ignored McDowell when the latter told her that he had phoned the Times and that Braverman was not a reporter there; McDowell correctly deduced th
weapons: During his prison break, the Gamesman used a .38 gun provided to him by Spider-Woman. In previous operations, his men used gas-guns and stun-guns provided by the Gamesman, but the Gamesman himself has not been seen using them.
weaknesses: While the Gamemaster boasted about the perfection of his crimes, he repeatedly bundled those, including the failure in the Los Angeles County Art Museum because he had not considered Spider-Woman a threat

timothy byrnes.name: Timothy Byrnes

After graduation, he and his wife got married and they had a son while in college. When Tony Stark revamped his company into Stark Resilient, Justine Hammer hired Spymaster to sabotage him. To this end, Spymaster assumed the identity of Leonard Pimacher. During this time, he developed a relationship with Tim Cababa, and came to love him truthfully. Spymaster saw himself forced to attack Tim when ordered to blow his cover, but avoided killing him.

timothy carney.name: Timothy Carney
timothy carney.origin: Timothy Carneywas the brother of Patrick Carney, the superhero known as the Yankee Clipper, and followed his example in becoming a superhero himself, calling himself Kid Justice. Both brothers were members of the superhero team known as the First Line. Growing up after the apparent death of his brother, Kid Justice became Mister Justice and participated in many missions for the team, but lost his life on their final mission, when they fought off a Skrull invasion in Earth's orbit. Mister Justice was distracted by the arrival of the time traveller Cassandra Locke, who was wearing his brother's time travel belt. When Mister Justice demanded she tell him where she got the belt, he was shot in the back by a Skrull warrior, killing him.

This incident caused Jonathan to work toward a dream of creating a "utopia" for mutants in need, recruiting them by force if necessary.

timothy hersberger.name: Timothy Hersberger
timothy hersberger.origin: Red Corker was a notorious killer and crime boss who was active in the San Francisco area in the 1940's until locked away in jail. However, during a prison riot, he escaped and returned to his old turf, setting up a hideout in the long abandoned Dream Island and continuing his criminal operations. The FBI sent their agent Dale Sturm to capture him. Corker had his men attempt to eliminate Sturm, an attempt what would apparently be a complete success. However, Dale survived, and after Red kidnapped the daughter of wealthy oil magnate George Dean, Dale tracked Corker to his hideout. There, Dale shot Corker dead, and his men were soon apprehended afterward.
