timothy jones adult.name: Timothy Jones (Adult)
timothy jones adult.origin: Nothing has been revealed about the past of Timothy Jones. Jones lived in a small shack in the woods with his lame daughter, Cathy. On the night of his daughter's eighth birthday, while walking in the woods, Jones found a pink doll in the tall grass. Not being able to afford a present for Cathy, Jones took the doll and gave it to her. Cathy grew attached to the doll and began telling her father that the doll could walk and talk on its own, but Jones simply brushed her claims off as fantasy. One night, the doll snuck out of the house. While it was checking to see if Jones was asleep, Jones woke up. The doll used hypnosis to put Jones back to sleep and snuck out the front door. The next morning, Jones woke up to find that Cathy was walking under her own power. Cathy told Jones that the doll was gone, but that she had found a solid brick of gold under her pillow. Jones looks up at the sky and wondered aloud what really happened and why.

timothy mulrooney.name: Timothy Mulrooney
timothy mulrooney.origin: left|thumb|As Tim A former student of Steve Jordan, he was there while Jordan sought the formula for the 'Wonder Fluid', a means of granting men increased resilience and strength. Knocking over some test tubes, a gas was released, knocking Jordan out while Tim managed to open an window. The gas granted them superpowers and they fought crime during the 1940s. When Captain Wonder disappeared, Tim continued as "Captain Tim, The Scourge of Crime", but he realized his powers were slowly fading. Eventually, in the 1960s, he retired from crime-fighting and opened an electronics store. He no longer felt "special" and this became something of an obsession. His aging slowed, he was still alive when Captain Wonder was discovered and revived. He begged Wonder to give him the formula for the Wonder Fluid in the hopes it might help with his advanced cancer, but Jordan had no ability to do so. With his last hope dashed, Tim stormed off while cursing his one-time mentor. Tim was last seen with his old cape leaping off a rooftop, presumably to his death.

tina deacon.origin: Detective Deacon was with her partner, Detective Ed Taylor as they responded to the scene of a supposed beating of Pistol Pat Albano by the vigilante Daredevil. As she was about to make her report, Taylor told her to not further investigate the situation as it would be a waste of paperwork as Mayor Fisk was gung-ho about the capture of heroes within the city. Deacon was about to wrap things up until the arrival of another patrol car. Detective Cole North stepped out of the vehicle and started his own questioning which angered Taylor. Cole asked Deacon about what happened and she answered that the victim only heard something and had no visual to go on. He then explained that he will write a report showing that Deacon was coerced by Taylor to obfuscate the perp's identity. She said she wanted to report it but explained that Taylor was against it.

tindly hardlesnop.name: Tindly Hardlesnop
tindly hardlesnop.origin: Tindly Hardlesnop was the top builder of the Brundlebuds, and one of the millions saved by the Silver Surfer when he stabilized their sun. While for most Brundlebuds things went back to normal after a while of praising the Surfer, Hardlesnop's love for him grew with each passing day. He focused his passion into building the Brundleboost Wonder-Suit, with which he left the planet to search for the Silver Surfer. thumb|left The miniature adventurer eventually crossed paths with his hero, and requested to become his helard, or as he misinterpreted it, his "Harold." Because of this, Tindly became the Surfer's second companion next to Dawn Greenwood, and became known as "Tiny Harold." Tiny Harold was crucial in helping his friends defeat several foes, including Cap'n Sharr, the mad mechanical moon of Mobos, and Blastaar, in each occasion using his small size to his advantage. Harold also showed his bravery when he set out to defeat the gigantic Null-Set, even though said creature was the size of a nebula. Hardlesnop left the Surfer and Dawn's side when they came across a miniature planet named Zeebie inhabited by creatures so small the Surfer couldn't detect them without enhancing his cosmic senses. After saving them from the collision of mote of space dust, which was equivalent to a meteor for them, Tindly decided to remain by their side and become their guardian and champion, knowing that as daunting and lonely said task was, it was a noble one. As they bid farewell, the Surfer promised Harold they would never forget him, and would also tell his tales.

tinkabelinos hardleg.origin: After a group of fairies kidnapped the son of a British cabinet minister, Tink was part of an MI13 strike team that assaulted Avalon and brought the child back. As part of a peace pact made with Oberon, she was united with Pete Wisdom in a sort of marriage. When the Skrull forces were invading Earth, Captain Britain was killed by them while trying to stop their invasion of Otherworld. Pete Wisdom then called for Tink to help them travel to Otherworld where they would ally with Avalon forces, and fight off the invasion together.
weapons: During the assault on Avalon, she used a flechette cannon specifically calibrated for small targets (specifically fairies).

tinkerbelle.name: Tinkerbelle
tinkerbelle.origin: Tinkerbelle was a Captain for one of the gladiator teams of the Royalist Forces controlled by the Elite. As ordered by Cheer Chadwick, she knocked down and captured Captain America and Falcon to attempt to turn them into serviceable arena combatants . As Captain America's Shield was stolen by one of the gladiators, Tinkerbelle offered Cap and Falcon a chance to regain it, as long as they would both participate in the Kill-Derby contest under her command . When the superheroes refused to take the gold for winning the death game, thereby forfeiting the game, Tinkerbelle and her team turned against them and attacked them in rage .
powers: None. Tinkerbelle was exceptionally strong with a large frame.

tinky weissman.name: Tinky Weissman
tinky weissman.origin: Tinky Weissman was an old friend of Janet van Dyne, otherwise known as the Avenger the Wasp. Janet had attended Tinky's coming-out party. Van Dyne ran into Tinky when she was vacationing in the Caribbean during a leave of absence from the Avengers. While at the Utopia Cay resort, Tinky introduced van Dyne to her new friend Walther Theodoric. Later, van Dyne ran into Tinky again while she was with her date 'Paul Denning' (actually the super-powered mercenary Paladin). Tinky invited the pair to a party on Theodoric's yacht. However van Dyne discovered Theodoric was actually the criminal Baron Brimstone, who planned to rob the resort's casino, and she and Paladin put a stop to his plans.

tiresias.name: Tiresias
tiresias.first_appearance: Marvel Classics Comics Series Featuring Vol 1 18: The Odyssey
tiresias.origin: ===Origin=== Tiresias was born and raised in the city of Thebes in ancient Greece. He was the son of a shepherd and a Nymph. thumb|left|250px Tiresias stumbled upon goddess Athena while she was bathing; as a result, the goddess decided to blind him. His mother begged Athena to lift the curse, but she refused to. Instead, she opened Tiresias' ears so he might hear all the whispers of the Gods. This two curses/gifts gave him a greater perspective of the world. He was traveling one day and found a pair of snakes in his path and killed them. Hera was angry at his action and decided to change his sex. As a woman, Tiresias served as a priestess of Hera. ===Hercules=== After the young baby Hercules killed the two snakes sent to kill him his parents Amphitryon and Alcmena went to Tiresias for advice. He revealed the truth of Hercules true parentage and that Zeus created him to be the champion of mankind. He saw his many future battles including one against the Hulk. ===Death=== When Tiresias died, their soul went to Hades, the Underworld, where they were visited by Odysseus who was on his ten year journey home known as the Odyssey. They gave him advice on how to continue on his voyage to Ithaca. ===Across the Ages=== At some point they returned to the land of the living as an immortal prophet. In 1782, they crashed at 's place during the time "Die Entführung aus dem Serail" had just opened to rave reviews. They enjoyed his many parties. She was also close friends of Ludwig van Beethoven and they had an interesting relationship as he/she was blind and he was deaf. This lead to an interesting confrontation with the Mayor of Vienna a story he/she still tells to this day. During the late 19th Century they got locked in the meat locker of famed French chef and restaurateur . They had never enjoyed such a good meal in all her long life. During the 1970s Tiresias lived in England where they picked up a cockney accent. They were in the studio when David Bowie recorded the "Low Album". ===Modern Era=== In the modern era they moved to the United States of America and opened a clock repair shop in New York City. They lived there with their dog Alfred Lord Tennyson. Hercules went to meet with Tiresias to ask for help and information of the Uprising Storm. They told him she would investigate, but as he left, they warned him about some "Lads" being in town and he would meet them in Central Park. As they were investigating the Uprising Storm they arrived the clock repair shop. They were beaten half to death and when Hercules came to visit them in the hospital they told him that they saw a vision just before the Uprising attacked them. They said Athena had come to claim him and take him back to Olympus, telling him his long tenure on Earth was over, that the world was changing and there's no place in it for him anymore. Horrorscope came to the hospital to finish them off but was interrupted by Sophia who had come for a visit. Horrorscope took the form of a doctor and left them in peace. Hercules invited Tiresias and the others back to his apartment where they shared dinner together toasting the battle. They shared their many stories of the famous people they had met in their long life. ===Gods of War=== After another defeat in battle, Tiresias and the others convinced Hercules to form a team of godly heroes to defeat the new gods. Hercules contacted his friends from across the globe for a meeting of the "Gods of War". He brought them to New York City to battle the Uprising Storm, but before the meeting could end the Uprising Storm attacked.
powers: Tiresias was gifted the power to see the many possible futures, and to hear the whispers of the Gods.

family: Unnamed shepherd father Unnamed Nymph mother

titanis.name: Titanis
titanis.first_appearance: Marvel Super Hero Contest of Champions Vol 1 1
titanis.origin: Titanis is one of the 100 Eternals who were created on Earth one million years ago by the First Host of the alien Celestials. During the Contest of Champions, she, Ikaris, Ajak and Sersi were flying high above the Andes Mountains when all four of them were teleported off-planet by the Grandmaster who was choosing champions from among the ranks of Earth's heroes in his game against Death. However, none of the abducted Eternals, including Titanis, were chosen to participate in the actual contest. Years later, Titanis was part of a team of Eternals led by Zuras who worked alongside the High Evolutionary to defend his Arctic Base from the New Warriors. Alongside her kin, she battled the New Warriors until Justice was able to convince Zuras that he had been misled into believing that the Celestials' judgement of humanity was imminent. Their alliance with the High Evolutionary no longer necessary, Titanis and the other Eternals abandoned the fight. Like all of the Eternals, Titanis died after the Final Host arrived but was resurrected by the Machine a few months later.
powers: Titanis possesses the usual enhanced physical attributes of an Eternal.

titus h crockett.name: Titus H. Crockett
titus h crockett.origin: Crooked business man Titus H. Crockett has dedicated his life to making as much money as possible, paying little mind to those he steps on to get it. One January morning, his secretary, Miss Raey, informs him that a man in the lobby is there to see Crockett about a "massive partnership" that will make tons of money. Crockett talks with the man, who refuses to give a name, about becoming partners. The man tells Crockett that before he shares his business plans, he must know if Crockett is scrupulous enough to be his partner. Crockett shares stories with the mystery man about his many dastardly deeds, including the time he swindled his own brother Carter out of his business, a move that drove Carter to suicide. Convinced, the businessman gives Crockett his business card and congratulates Crockett on becoming "one of his boys". Crockett is ecstatic about the partnership, but his excitement soon fades when he experiences a heart attack. As he breathes his last breath, Crockett looks at the business card and realizes he just made a deal with Satan.

titus locke.name: Titus Locke
titus locke.origin: Titus Locke was a resident of Freetown during the 1940s. He was the owner of the Freetown News, as well as its biggest employer and principal industry: the Tool Works. By the summer of 1942, he was deeply involved in war profiteering and labor crushing. This information came to pass the hands of Ella Wright who attempted to tip off newspaper reporter Jerry Dash of the rival paper the Star. To avoid this from getting out to the public, Titus had Ella murdered and framed Jerry for the killing. This prompted Jerry's friend Roddy Colt to learn the truth in his secret identity of the Secret Stamp. When the Secret Stamp managed to find proof that Jerry was not in town when the murder happened, Locke attempted to rally a lynch mob to hang Jerry instead. However, the Secret Stamp convinced the mob to let the law handle Jerry through a fair trial. When Titus attempted to get the mob going again, the Stamp accused him of the murder of Ella Wright and tackled him. Later, in a court of law, Jerry brought the full story to light with enough evidence to prove that Locke was responsible for Ella's murder. Locke's sentence and ultimate fate is unrecorded.

tityus.name: Tityus
tityus.origin: Tityus was the giant son of Zeus and the mortal Orchomenan princess Elara (though he has been described as a Titan on occasion). At a vengeful Hera's behest, Tityus attempted to rape Leto (daughter of the Titans Coeus and Phoebe), but was slain by Leto's twins Phoebus Apollo and Artemis and confied to Tartarus, where he remained among Zeus' most hated. There, vultures were to eat his immortal liver day after day, up to the modern era.

tiv scavenger.name: Tiv (Scavenger)
tiv scavenger.origin: Tiv and Biv were two scavengers living in the ruins of Titan. They confronted Thanos when he walked into what they claimed was their territory. Due to the villain's weakened state, neither Tiv nor Biv believed his claims of his identity, and proceeded to beat him up and steal his supplies. They were scared off by a flash of Champion's ship, and ran away. Later, when Thane came looking for his father, he learned from Biv and Tiv that the Mad Titan had left with Nebula, Champion, and Starfox. Thane then beheaded the scavengers before leaving.

tiwaz.name: Tiwaz
tiwaz.species: Elder God; Asgardian, first of the Aesir
tiwaz.origin: ===Origin=== Tiwaz was an Elder God embodying wisdom who emerged alongside other Elder Gods of Earth such as Gaea, Chthon, Set, Toranos, "Utgard-Loki", etc. when the Demiurge seeded the planet. When the Godwar broke out among the corrupted Elder Gods, Gaea birthed Atum to destroy them. Tiwaz (seemingly uncorrupted) faced and bested Atum using his wile and wit, and went his way wandering, and siring his own children . When he heard that "Utgard-Loki" and Toranos were going into exile together, he sent his servant Whiteface to inform Gaea. At some point, he ventured into Andlang but was frozen solid when he stood there for too long. The Norse cow Audumbla found him and licked him free, and he became known by another name: Buri. Buri was the first of the Aesir who were worshiped as gods by the ancient Viking and Germanic tribes of Northern Europe. In the myths and legends, Buri was the third entity to arise in creation, after the giant Ymir and the cow Audumbla. Intrigued, the Giants allowed Buri to live. Buri grew wise and strong and took a Frost Giantess as wife, and had three sons: Bor, Mimir and Njord. ===Succession=== He was succeeded by Bor after his son bested him in combat, and his other son Njord left to found Vanaheim and sire the Vanir. Bor in turn took a wife (the giantess Bestla) and fathered his sons. As Bor founded Asgard, home of the Aesir, Buri went to live recluse, returning to his original name Tiwaz, in the northern reaches of Asgard, in Nastrond, living among ephemeral servants he created by sculpting ice and animated with life. After Bor's death, Odin challenged and bested Buri as well. During the Aesir/Vanir War, Tiwaz witnessed from afar the death of Mimir (a peace hostage given by Odin), decapitated by the Vanir, and the eventual annexation of the Vanir to Asgard. He was eventually forgotten by the Asgardians. After Thor was born, Tiwaz visited him. ===Modern Age=== ====Nursing Thor==== thumb|right|Tiwaz and his bird, Whiteface (Earth-616)|Whiteface Tiwaz learned about Odin's death, and left footsteps for the grieving Thor to follow. He later discovered him after a brutal battle with Hela and took him and Mjolnir to his home. He nursed Thor back to health, wrestling with him in friendly matches to test him. Thor once believed him to be Odin, but Tiwaz proved him wrong. The sorcerer also refuted the story told by Odin's Eye about Odin's origin. He returned to normal strength and was able to beat Tiwaz. He then encouraged Thor to return to Asgard, and the Odinson departed Tiwaz's company, unaware that he was in fact Buri. He was directed to Frigga and the children who had went in hiding during Surtur's attack on Asgard. ====Helping the New Mutants==== Thor told Volstagg's children about Tiwaz, and they later fred Hrimhari, Boom Boom and Warlock from an Asgardian prison, sending them to recruit the aid of the Giant-sorcerer. They had nearly reached Tiwaz's dwelling, when they were caught in a net and captured by a Frost Giant serving Hela. They escaped from the Frost Giant's grasp, and Tiwaz appeared, imprisoning the Frost Giant in a block of ice. Tiwaz brought them into his cave, warmed them up and advised them on the true extent of Hela's threat and of her new sword, able to slay Odin and fell the World Tree. Tiwaz revealed the location of the Warriors Three and sent Hrimhari and the two New Mutants to free them from Queen Ula and her Savage Swarm of Hive Trolls. Tiwaz stayed behind and watched them. They managed to free the Warriors Three, though it required Tiwaz's magic to shrink Volstagg so that Warlock could fly him away. Later Tiwaz monitored from his home Karnilla's attempt to revive one of her stone-petrified men. She failed, but Tiwaz concentrated the excess magic from her spell to revive all people of Nornheim, still in their stone form. With Tiwaz' secret support, Hela's army was defeated and retreated to Hel. He later sent an ice-fairy to Asgard, transporting a vial using whose content transformed the people of Nornheim back into men of flesh and blood, and a map allowing the New Mutants to return to Midgard. ===Reuniting with Thor=== When Tyr became corrupted by a Skinner Box, Thor and his siblings went looking for him. He inadvertently found Tiwaz, who possessed the that could restore Tyr's soul. Tiwaz told Thor about his history as an Elder God and his identity as Buri. After answering a "riddle," Thor was given the rune and used it to fill the missing portion of Tyr's soul, thus removing Oblivion's influence. Afterwards, Tiwaz journeyed to Utgard to warn Utgard-Loki not to attack Andlang, as the ensuing war would have no winners. He met with Loki next to discuss their spell.
abilities: As the progenitor to the Norse gods, he possessed the same abilities as his grandson, Odin. He is a skilled ice- and was worthy of Mjolnir.
weapons: Spear.

fields.notes: Tiwaz/Buri's true origin is an Elder God, but there are many alternative, mythological accounts to his origin: According to the legend, he was delivered from the ice by the magic cow licking it, the hair the first day, the head the second day, and Buri itself the third. Other accounts state he emerged from the ice by himself. Another legend states Audumbla licked his form from an ice block. He was also claimed to be Ymir's son by Doctor Strange. According to the book "A guide to Norse Religion," Buri was born at Ginnungagap the same way and alongside Ymir. It also claimed Buri produced Odin, Vili, and Ve without mention of Bor. Like how Toranos is the "Utgard-Thor" and "The-One-Who-Cannot-Be-Named" is the "Utgard-Loki," Tiwaz is the "Utgard-Odin."
fields.trivia: is a letter in the Runic alphabet, approximately equivalent to "T", and is connected with the god and therefore with victory and honor. In Marvel Comics, Buri is named Tiwaz; he and Tyr Odinson share the same rune. This was relevant when Tiwaz's rune restored Tyr's soul.

tlaloc.name: Tláloc
tlaloc.origin: Tláloc was the Aztec god of the storm. Long ago, he was chosen by his parents Ometecuhtli and Omecíhuatl to rule the Tēteoh pantheon of gods under the Third Sun. However, this world was brought to an end when the continued feuding of his brothers Tezcatlipoca and Quetzalcoatl caused fire to reign down upon the world and destroy it. Later, Tláloc was among the storm gods assembled from across Earth’s pantheons at Hjem Spíti (the neutral realm for all pantheons) to decide whether to join forces with the self-proclaimed storm god Ororo Munroe of Earth (at the time possessed by Eternity, the embodiment of the current universe) or the Mesopotamian storm god Ba’al Hadad of the Annunaki, who sought to destroy the current universe and construct a new one. Although Tláloc and many of his fellow storm gods decided to side with Ba’al Hadad, they were soon attacked by Hadad and the Black Winters under his control.

tnneya.name: Tnneya
tnneya.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 58: Silver Surfer: The Enslavers
tnneya.origin: Tnneya was the lover of Mrrungo-Mu who tried to escape her lover after she had been exasperated by his power hungry and tyrannical behavior. She was rescued by the Silver Surfer after she had attempted to escape in one of Mrrungo-Mu's ships and was caught by his forces. She managed to seduce the Silver Surfer by tricking him into believing that she was his one true love, Shalla-Bal. The Surfer eventually saw through this deception and went to Mrrungo in order to save Shalla-Ball after she had been captured by Mrrungo-Mu and all those captured by the Enslavers under his control. When Mrrungo was defeated, Tnneya pleaded for the life of Mrrungo to be spared and they were permitted to leave together to parts unknown.
powers: Tnneya had the ability to make anyone who saw her perceive her appearance and characteristics as that of their one true love

He later joined Unus' Gang, a group of surviving mutants led by Unus the Untouchable who hindered the work of Professor X, Magneto, and his allies toward the reconstruction of the island. Later Unus' Gang, including Toad-In-Waiting, joined forces with Professor X and his allies to fight for the good of Genosha. Although most of Unus' Gang members were confirmed depowered on M-Day, Toad-In-Waiting's current status is unknown, especially if he retained his powers.
powers: Toad-In-Waiting's physical attributes are mostly identical to Toad's powers, including flexible bone structure, , prehensile tongue and more.

tobe.name: Tobe
tobe.origin: Not much is known about Tobe, except that he was either a Morlock taken by Mikhail Rasputin to the alternate dimension known as "The Hill" or else one of the new generation of Morlocks born in that dimension. In any case, like all residents of The Hill, Tobe sought to fight his way to the top and thereby join Mikhail's elite warriors. When Storm was brought to The Hill by Mikhail, Tobe, along with three other Morlocks, attacked her, hoping to use her defeat to buy their way further up The Hill. Storm was initially dazed by an unexpected plasma bolt from Tobe, but quickly recovered and defeated all her attackers by summoning gale-force winds.
powers: Tobe could through unknown means produce a type of red, harmful plasma which he could use to attack others. His physical structure resembled that of an ape, and he had purple fur, three-fingered hands and three-toed feet.

tobias space phantom.name: Tobias (Space Phantom)
tobias space phantom.origin: Tobias was a Space Phantom employed by Immortus in a complex plan to keep the Avengers occupied before the coming of Onslaught. According to his fabricated history, Tobias and his brother Malachi had been taken away from their true parents by Kang the Conqueror, actually Immortus posing as him, in order to turn them into the heirs to Kang and Mantis' Dynasty. Tobias and Malachi were sent by their adoptive mother Mantis to capture her former husband, the Cotati Swordsman, again another Space Phantom. As members of the Anachronauts, Malachi and Tobias clashed with the Avengers several times, and, after having followed the Avengers through a time portal, Tobias ended up in an alternate past, from where he was rescued and taken back to Kang's Citadel by his brother Malachi. Later, Malachi and Tobias were apparently slayed during their last battle against the Avengers.

fields.notes: When Crossing was first published, all the characters who appeared were intended to be who they actually were. Since the whole storyline started to make almost no sense after some author changes and continuity errors between the various series, Kurt Busiek retconned the entire event in into being a plan devised by Immortus in order to have the Avengers occupied before the upcoming threat of Onslaught. Nearly all the antagonists, except for Kang who was retconned into being Immortus, were then retconned into being Space Phantoms. It is likely that Malachi was originally intended to be an adult version of Tommy Maximoff, given that he is an older twin brother taken from his original parents at a young age, shares visual elements with Wanda Maximoff and Vision, and refers to "Luna Maximoff" as his cousin.

tobias cobb.name: Tobias Cobb
tobias cobb.origin: Tobias Cobb was an agent of the DEMV, the Department of Extranormal Motor Vehicles. Cobb accompanied his associate, Harriet Underhill, when she notified the Fantastic Four that Franklin and Valeria Richards were not permitted to drive any of the team's vehicles, and returned two days later to administer them a full driver's exam. Cobb administered Franklin's exam, and he performed poorly. During the exam, the emergency autopilot of each sibling's Fantasticar kicked in and they passed through a dimensional rift into the Microverse, where the Fantastic Four confronted the would-be invader Gargantua. During the confrontation, Franklin stepped out of the Fantasticar to convince Gargantua to stop her plan, leaving Cobb behind on the vehicle with its shields on. Since Franklin had pulled his vehicle over at the frist sign of trouble and ensured his passenger's safety, Cobb passed him.

tobias ford.name: Tobias Ford
tobias ford.origin: Tobias Ford was working on a particle accelerator as an employee of when he developed a crush on his superior, Hannah Hutchins. He sabotaged the accelerator in order to engineer a chance meeting with her. One of these acts of sabotage went unnoticed however, and the accelerator exploded, seemingly killing Ford and numerous other maintenance workers. In fact, the explosion had torn open a portal to an alien world, and Ford was trapped between the two realms, the other one he designated to be "Hell". Ford would sporadically materialize in and out of the physical world, however others mistook his fleeting visits as Hannah, who had survived the accident, gaining telekinetic abilities after the incident. He used his ability to protect Hannah from her neighbors, who blamed Hannah for the accident. This only caused them to fear her, while Hannah herself became convinced that she was being plagued by demons. This brought her to the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D., who brought Hannah aboard the Bus to look into the origins of her abilities. Ford assumed S.H.I.E.L.D. had arrested her, and attacked Agent Coulson and his team, almost crashing the Bus in the process. However, the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents on board realized that Ford had been behind the sabotage, and Agent May lured him out onto the ground using Hannah as bait. After a short fight, Hannah begged him to stop. Dropping to his knees, Ford expressed remorse for his actions. May then convinced him to let Hannah go. Also with that, Ford completely faded away.
weapons: As Tobias was holding a wrench at the time of the accident, he carried it with him into the limbo between worlds, and used it as a weapon.
weaknesses: Mental impairment: Ford seemed to be slow to understand things. Such as the fact he was putting his coworkers in danger by loosening the bolts. Even when between worlds, he sought to protect Hannah

tobias mefis.name: Tobias Mefis
tobias mefis.origin: In the 1940's, Dr. Mefis operated as a psychiatrist using the skill of hypnosis to coerce his patients into giving him their valuables and make them forget it. His patients then went on to think they were robbed, earning Mefis the name of the "Phantom Burglar" in the newspapers. He operated out of a private residence with his receptionist, a man apparently from India -- suggesting that perhaps Mefis learned his hypnotic abilities in that region. His plot attracted the attention of newspaper reporter Deadline Dawson and his detective friend Terry Vance. They went to the home of the most recent victim, Mrs. Kaye, arriving just as Kaye was returning home from a visit with Dr. Mefis. Mefis told the young men that Kaye was in no condition to be interviewed and asked them to leave. By this point, Terry's pet monkey Dr. Watson had stolen a list of clients out of Mefis's back pocket and showed it to Terry, Deadline, and Mrs. Kaye's daughter Jane. They were surprised to find that the names on the client list were also all of the victims of the Phantom Burglar. Seeking to catch Mefis in the act, Terry disguised himself as an old man and went to visit Mefis at his private office. There, the boy detective proved to be no match for the hypnotic powers of Dr. Mefis who ordered the boy to return home and cut his own throat. This was stopped by the timely arrival of Deadline, Dr. Watson, and Jane Kaye. The hypnotic spell was broken when Dr. Watson wrapped his tail around Mefis's throat and threatened to strangle him. Surrendering, Mefis then attempted to escape when the authorities were called. He ran into his receptionist's pet boa constrictor and cowered, but his life was saved by Terry who cut the giant snake in half with a sword. With the police on the scene, Dr. Mefis was taken into custody and his operation exposed. His subsequent fate is unrevealed.
abilities: however, they appear to be nothing more than a psychological trick as opposed to any sort of super-human mind control ability.

tobias messenger.name: Tobias Messenger
tobias messenger.species: Mutant born at the end of the 19th Century
tobias messenger.origin: Tobias Messenger was born in 1859, and because he was deaf and mute since birth, lived a solitary life until he was 19 years old, at which point his telepathic powers emerged. By the age of 30, Messenger began traveling the world looking for other mutants like himself. He succeeded in finding a few mutant allies, none of whom were very powerful compared to the X-Men and their contemporaries (a difference that Messenger attributed to the dawn of atomic power during the 20th century). Nevertheless, Messenger and his allies were able to influence world events through their concerted efforts, and Messenger credits his group with bringing about a quicker end to the first World War. Eventually his allies died or moved on, leaving Messenger alone again, and he decided to place himself in suspended animation. Emerging once every ten years, he sought out new mutants to join his cause. Messenger formed the Promise during the 1930s to 40s in an attempt to protect mutants from prejudiced humans. He believed that war between mutants and baseline humans was inevitable, and although mutants were certain to emerge victorious in the conflict, the result would be chaos as various mutant factions fought each other. Messenger planned to take a leadership position in post-war, mutant-run world. The Promise eventually came into a conflict with the original team of X-Men when they abducted Lorna Dane, Havok, and the Angel, placing them in stasis tubes along with themselves as they began their next ten-year sleep. However, Promise member Lucy Robinson tampered with her own stasis tube and Angel's, allowing them to escape and free the others. Robinson, blaming Messenger for robbing her of her life and family, killed him after helping the X-Men escape.
weaknesses: Tobias could not speak and relied on his telepathy to communicate.

toby mutant.name: Toby (Mutant)
toby mutant.origin: Toby was a mutant baby whose mother had her car stolen by carjackers while he was still inside it. The stress of the situation triggered his mutant powers, quickly turning his cries into a sonic scream which knocked out the carjackers and started to wreak havoc. Wolverine and Honey Badger managed to approach the car, but they were blown away when Laura tried to cover Toby's mouth. Jean Grey arrived to the scene and telepathically calmed down the baby, additionally implanting a psychic suggestion not to cry so much. Jean subsequently returned Toby to his mother, while also telepathically contacting her colleague Beast to have him make Toby a dampener necklace. She then suggested Toby's mother to have him attend the Xavier Institute for Mutant Education and Outreach when he was old enough in order to learn how to control his powers.

On a stormy night, Toby was awakened and came to the window to notice Ikaris, floating outside. Ikaris explained that he was here to protect Toby. Later, after the storm had cleared, Ikaris was invited inside to chat with Toby and his family. Toby learned, although Ikaris was unsure why, that Ikaris was here to protect him with his life if necessary. While Ikaris was away trying to hunt down a traitor within the Eternal community, Sprite took Ikaris' place in protecting Toby. While accompanying Toby to a park, Sprite protected Toby from a surge of energy that resulted from the damage done to the resurrection machines Eternals used to resurrect themselves after death. Later, Toby died after his life force was used to resurrect Ikaris.

tod kaufman.name: Tod Kaufman
tod kaufman.origin: When Cassandra discovered she was pregnant, she left Tod Kaufman because he was working for HYDRA and she didn't want their daughter to know her father is a monster. Cassandra's daughter turned out to be a mutant with razor pointed spikes sprouting from various parts of her body. At some point, she contracted a rare blood disease and required a bone marrow transplant to survive. To save her life Cyclops dispatched Wolverine and X-Force to infiltrate Hydra Base 2994 and kidnap General Kaufman. X-Force forcibly brought Kaufman to Saint Francis Memorial Hospital in San Francisco were they explained his daughter's illness and the need for his bone marrow. Before he could reply, HYDRA stormed into the hospital to extract Kaufman. Without time to give a proper sample, Kaufman allow Wolverine to cut off his left arm, and told his ex-wife that she should have told him about their daughter before leaving. Presumably, with the bone marrow from her father, she recovered from her illness.

Before he could reply, HYDRA stormed into the hospital to extract Kaufman. Without time to give a proper sample, Kaufman allow Wolverine to cut off his left arm, and told his ex-wife that she should have told him about their daughter before leaving. Presumably, with the bone marrow from her father, she recovered from her illness.

tod perry.name: Tod Perry
tod perry.origin: Tod Perry built a hotel on the crater of a meteor that had recently fallen to Earth. Since the crater attracted many tourists, the hotel was also a great success, until the day the hotel manager pointed out to Mr. Perry that suddenly a fourth elevator had appeared in the hotel lobby where only three had been built, and the elevator was driven by a strange guy. Perry forced the elevator door, forcing the elevator operator to start it even though the elevator operator told him that it was not convenient and that it would be the elevator's last trip, in fact the elevator did not simply go up to the hotel but instead took flight, as what had fallen to Earth was not a meteor but rather an alien spaceship, and the aliens used the fourth elevator as transportation to return to their planet, but because of Perry's actions he too was transported to the alien world not knowing if he would ever return.

tod sultan.name: Tod Sultan
tod sultan.origin: thumb|left|142px|Sultan posing as the Black Rider Tod Sultan was an outlaw who was active during the days of the American Frontier. A wanted outlaw, Sultan tried to seek refuge in the town of Leadville, Texas and was shot by the sheriff. He was only winged in the shoulder and managed to hide out in the doctor's office owned by Matthew Masters. When Masters returned to his practice, Sultan forced him to give him medical treatment for his bullet wound. He then knocked the doctor out and tied him up. Seeking a disguise to slink out of town in, Sultan instead found Matthew's Black Rider costume and decided to use it to pose as the hero. Dressed as the Black Rider, Tod gunned down the sheriff and fled town, leaving the real Black Rider to take the rap. On his way out of town he crossed paths with Marie Lathrop and her brother Bobby. Recognizing them as the children of wealthy rancher Jim Lathrop, Sultan kidnapped Marie and told Bobby that he was ransoming Marie for $10,000. Bobby instead rode to the doctor's office where he found Matthew tied up and helped free him. Matthew then rode on his horse Satan to the meeting place, and while hiding behind a bush to protect his double-identity from Marie, lassoed up his impostor. Matthew then forced Tod to remove his costume, but when Masters was putting it on Tod tried to escape by riding out on Satan. However, the Black Rider's horse bucked Sultan off his back, sending the outlaw falling down a cliff to his death. With Marie saved, she was able to clear the Black Rider's good name.
weapons: Sultan carried a six shooter.

todd baker.name: Todd Baker
todd baker.origin: Todd Baker was a senator who was trying to reinstate S.H.I.E.L.D. He was secretly colluding with terrorist Veronica Eden, who intended to become the head of Hydra, so together they could steer the conflict between the two organizations whichever way they saw fit, and so dismantle foreign governments and neutralize hostile powers. Baker had little say in Eden's plan, and he only provided resources. Their operation extended to other like-minded people, such as the rookie super hero team called the Paladins. When Iron Man and Captain America became tangled in Eden's plot, they deduced Baker's participation, and Eden later confirmed it. Stark eventually tracked him down and confronted him after the Paladins had accidentally caused the reactivation of the Overseer, a super-computer bent on world domination.

todd davis.name: Todd Davis
todd davis.origin: Todd Davis lived in Westview, New Jersey with his wife Sharon. Following Wanda Maximoff's transformation of Westview into a sitcom reality, Todd and his wife were placed under Wanda's mind control to assume the roles of Arthur Hart and his wife, Mrs. Hart. As Arthur Hart, he was the director of Computational Services, Inc., and the boss of Vision and Norm. In the 1950's-themed episode, Wanda and Vision had to host the Harts for an impromptu dinner party, in order for Vision to receive a promotion from Mr. Hart. During the dinner, the Harts kept pressing the newly wed couple for background on their relationship, which caused Wanda to start choking Mr. Hart, while Mrs. Hart could only keep smiling and repeatedly saying "stop it." Despite this, Vision saved Mr. Hart at the command of Wanda and got the promotion. Eventually, Todd was freed from Wanda's control. Sometime later, he passed away, leaving his wife a widow.

todd hunter.name: Todd Hunter
todd hunter.origin: The owner of Hunter Technologies, Hunter was betrayed by his wife and her lover Jack Cameron, who conspired against him and gave him for dead, taking control of his company. Hunter survived and developed telekinetic powers. Using a disguise and the nom-de-guerre Lazarus, Hunter sabotaged Hunter Technologies activities. This caused a problem with the Pantheon, a superhero team that bought supplies from HT. When the Pantheon members Hector, Ulysses, and Hulk investigated, they found the truth. After Lazarus killed Cameron, Mrs. Hunter surrendered to the police at the Hulk's request. Lazarus later watched how his son, who had had repeated money troubles, was being harassed by his criminal creditors. Lazarus again fought the Hulk, still on his trail, to avoid any interruption in this issue. Although Lazarus saved his son's life, he rudely insisted the kid should look for a job. ===After Civil War=== After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.
powers: most useful against inanimate objects.

todd kettle.name: Todd Kettle
todd kettle.origin: Todd Kettle was a governor who worked for the Kingpin. Daredevil and Elektra Natchios learned of his connections and infiltrated his summer home. Once inside the home, Daredevil and Elektra were quick to confront Governor Kettle in his office and asked him why he placed an order with the Commissioner of Police to make Hell's Kitchen a “No-Man's-Land.” A nervous Governor Kettle revealed that the Stromwyn Family, his biggest donors, had asked him to put in the order. Daredevil demanded to know why he would do that. Governor Kettle admitted that it didn't matter because the Stromwyn Family owned the cops, him, and the news. The Governor went on to call Daredevil "just some guy in a mask who no one will listen to."

todd ziller.name: Todd Ziller
todd ziller.species: Human mutate using a mix of a dozen different transformative substances, including the Super-Soldier Serum, Gamma enhancements, Mutant Growth Hormone, Pym Particles, and the Connors Formula
todd ziller.origin: U.S. Army Corporal Todd Ziller was the test subject of a procedure by Project: Troubleshooter, America's latest division in human weapons, in yet another attempt to re-create Abraham Erskine's Super-Soldier Serum. Due to the difficulty of re-creating said formula, most of the knowledge gaps were filled with hacked and reverse-engineered versions of a dozen other transformative substances. The final result included Gamma enhancements, Mutant Growth Hormone, Pym Particles, and the Connors Formula. The ensuing application of the serum in Ziller's body turned him into a giant dinosaur-like reptile that was similar in appearance to Godzilla, for which he was given the alias of the "American Kaiju". When Avengers Idea Mechanics performed an illegal operation to rescue Rick Jones from S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, the American Kaiju was unleashed for the first time to attack Avengers Island. Ziller was attacking A.I.M.'s facilities when he encountered opposition in the form of A.I.M.'s the Avenger Five. The Avenger Five fought the American Kaiju in order to buy A.I.M. enough time to evacuate Avengers Island. Using the exceeding energy from one of the Avenger Five's Gamma reactors, they shorted out Ziller's Gamma enhancements, turning him back into his human form. De-powered, Ziller found his way to Castle Kruger, Lichtenbad, where he assisted mad scientist Victor Vandoom in perfecting his monster serum using the lingering traces of the Kaiju Formula in Ziller's body. In compensation, Vandoom turned Ziller back into the American Kaiju, and had him fight Deadpool and the Red Hulk, the latter having being sent by S.H.I.E.L.D. to retrieve Ziller. The Red Hulk managed to defeat the American Kaiju and hurled him against Castle Kruger, knocking him down and turning him back into a human again. Ziller was subsequently apprehended. During the symbiote invasion of Knull, Ziller was deployed with Sandman One to purge Knull's symbiote dragons. In his kaiju form, Ziller exterminated the beasts and cleared the area, albeit causing a ton of damage in the process. Sandman One then administered the antidote to Ziller and turned him back into a human again once the mission was complete and returned him to base.
abilities: Skilled Combatant: Ziller, as a soldier, is a highly trained unarmed fighter. Marksmanship: Ziller is a skilled marksman.

togaro.name: Togaro
togaro.origin: Togaro was a tyrant who lived on the microworld of Mita where he sought to overthrow the king and queen of the realm. Fearing for their daughter's life, they sent her to Earth where she was adopted and named Dianna. Learning of this by the time Dianna was an adult, Togaro led his minions to the surface world, where they used their size-changing drugs to grow to gigantic size and terrorize the Earth. This attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky who, coincidentally, were friends of Dianna in their civilian guises of Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes. Defeating Togaro's minions, they soon learned that Dianna went missing, and they were confronted by Togaro himself, who warned them and Dianna's brother Frank to stay away from Bird Nests' Island. They went anyway, and learned of Dianna's origins. Returning to Frank's cabin to make more of the size-changing drug, they were unaware that Togaro (having shrunk in size) had smuggled himself along on Bucky's boot. Seeking to stop them from traveling to Mita, he used the drugs to grow a cockroach to human size, but the creature was fought off by Cap and Bucky. Using the size-changing drug, the two heroes chased Togaro into a knot of wood in the hardwood flooring of the cabin, but the villain managed to escape them and retreated. He once more hitched a ride back to Mita, hiding on Bucky's body for the trip, and almost succeeded in killing them by again growing an insect in size -- this time an ant. On Mita, Togaro then kidnapped Bucky and the Mitan known as Ahlma and set a device that sent Mita hurtling into its own sun. He and his men then retreated to the cracks of the rock where the atomic world of Mita existed. There, they were followed by Captain America, Dianna, and Frank, who rescued Bucky and Ahlma and returned to the surface world. Togaro followed after them and took his size-changing drugs to grow to massive size. Captain America matched him in size and during their final struggle, Togaro was knocked down and fatally struck his head on the side of a cliff and died, ending his threat once and for all.

toko.name: Toko
toko.origin: ===Inferno Babies=== Toko was one of the Inferno Babies used to open portals to Limbo and taken by Project Purgatory. Using information from Cameron Hodge, Ten mutant children were kidnapped, by N'astirh's N'asteris, during the Inferno. The infants arrived in a cemetery, where the demon N'astirh was attempting to create a permanent portal open between the demon infested dimension of Limbo and Earth. The infants were teleported to Times Square, where the New Mutant, Magik, was opening a portal to return her teammates from Limbo and N'astirh, using the babies as the points of an inverted pentagram (focusing beams of power because of their purity and openness to use them as natural, living conduits who could not block the flow of power and who would not know how to shut it off), kept the portal open. N'astirh attempted to used them, and baby Christopher Summers, who later grew-up to become Cable, to open a portal from Limbo to Earth and was partially successful in merging the two realms. The X-Terminators and the New Mutants saved the children. After the defeat of N'astirh, the Goblin Queen attempted to sacrifice baby Christopher and the other nine mutant babies atop the Empire State Building to finish N'astirh's work and permanently open a gateway between Earth and Limbo. The invasion was thwarted after the Goblin Queen committed suicide in combat with Marvel Girl, attempting to kill everyone in her power. After the X-Terminators and New Mutants took the babies to X-Factor's Celestial Ship, X-Factor turned the babies over to the US government, while being attacked by Nanny and Orphan-Maker. ===Project Purgatory=== For many years the fate of children remained unknown. Following the Inferno, the United States Army founded Project Purgatory to research the fields of the supernatural and paranormal. One of the recruited scientists, Doctor Noc, developed technology to use the children to open portals to Limbo. General Ulysses, Doctor Noc, and a trained band of military soldiers established a military base in Limbo, the Hatchery. At the base, they continued to experiment, both on demons and on the Inferno babies, and train new soldiers. However, when the soldiers recovered the Bloodstone amulet, the base was attacked by Witchfire and the Inferno babies were believed dead. The Earth based military forces sealed off the portal Epsilon, leaving those on the Limbo base stranded to find the observation portal with virtually no hope of escape. After 26 years in Limbo, but only 4 years on Earth, Noc and Ulysses were able to locate a traveling portal and return home, keeping the existence of the children to themselves. However, they never gave up their mission of taking control of Limbo and capturing Illyana Rasputin. They returned to a world where all of the mutants were living together, on Utopia. and, therefore, their commanding officer, General Combest, ordered them to stand-down. The unit still believed that Illyana was a significant threat and, after Project Purgatory kidnapped Pixie, the Inferno Babies revealed themselves when they killed General Combest and obliterated the entire battalion. The New Mutants showed to rescue Pixie and the Inferno Babies defeated them. After Dr. Noc and General Ulysses took Illyana's Soulsword and Pixie's Souldagger, they extracted the Bloodstones and completed the Bloodstone Amulet to call forth the Elder Gods. They, along with members of Project Purgatory, tortured the New Mutants. Once they returned to Limbo, the Demons Three asked them to turn over the Bloodstone Amulet and General Ulysses had them beg for mercy, then killed. After releasing the Elder Gods, General Ulysses was killed attempting to control them and the group fought against a demon horde. While fighting, Toko's whereabouts were unknown.
powers: and some degree of immovability. Even the Soulsword ricocheted harmlessly off her.

tokugawa ieyasu.origin: Tokugawa Ieyasu was a warlord in Japan. The Shogun Tokugawa was one of the warlords who brought Japan's civil wars to an end, become its ruler. tolan.name: Tolan
tolan.origin: According to Atlantean legend, Tolan was the overlord of Atlantis prior to the Great Cataclysm, at a time where land covered the Earth and no large bodies of water existed. Tolan was allegedly an ancestor of the Atlantean Royal Family. Tolan was a wise and beloved ruler. In his old age felt a bad omen for his people. This omen came true when Nagorbu developed a magnet that could repel human flesh in an effort to solidify the military might of Atlantis and allow them to attract and conquer planets, with the ultimate goal of ruling the universe. Tolan refused to use the weapon and ordered it to be dumped into the ocean, refusing to have Atlantis become a warmongering nation. A combination of the magnet and Nagorbu's war-hungry followers attempts to recover it caused a massive flood over the centuries, well after Tolan and Nagorbu died. A tidal wave caused by the digging and atomic disruption of the land (due to some of the means used by Nagorbu and his followers) which ultimately sank Atlantis. Tolan's legend was passed down by the Atlanteans, who sometimes invoked his name.

fields.notes: The only recorded tale of Tolan was told in (January, 1949) by the Sub-Mariner to Betty Dean. Namor presented it as a legend passed down, and admitted that he was unsure of how much truth there is to the story. While the story contradicts the known facts surrounding Atlantis during the Pre-Cataclysmic Age, and the Great Cataclysm, it does not discount that Tolan ever existed. Atlantis' profile in (March, 2008) mentions the story but point out it contradicts with historical evidence, while the Great Cataclysm's profile in (March, 2011) states that those events, along a series of other causes to the Great Cataclysm, was unrevealed to have actually had any influence on the event, locally or globally. It remains unrevealed whether there is any truth to the relation between Namor and Tolan. Tolan isn't mentioned as relative in the profiles of Atlantean royalty in handbooks, including Namor's, Namora's and Namorita's profiles in (June, 2009), nor in Thakorr's profiles in (January, 2010) and (December, 2011).

The males and females of the Badoon race despised each other so much that the males of the species developed interstellar travel capabilities and found another world on which to live. The males only returned once a year to procreate in order to propagate the species. Unlike the males of the species, female Badoon were peaceful in nature. When the male Badoon occupation of Earth was ended, Tolaria and the females took them into custody.

toltec.origin: ===Origins=== Despite Toltec being classified as an human vigilante, Steve Rogers stated that Thor hypothesized (basing himself on Toltec's name and appearance inspired by Aztec Lore) that he could possibly be an Aztec demigod, or an agent empowered by Tezcatlipoca, god of war and vengeance. ===Vigilante=== For some unknown period, Toltec has been acting as a vigilante in Mexico City and central-eastern Mexico countryside. Eventually he started targeting members of the Cuiliacan Cartel, and those killings were initially attributed to a rival cartel. Steve Rogers' interpretation of Policía Federal reports stated Toltec believed he was avenging the poor and disadvantaged Mexicans by slaughtering and dismembering the criminals who would prey upon them. Through his actions, he indeed attained a legendary status among the lower class, but also among the law enforcement agents and criminals alike. Many in the Distrito Federal also believed he was indeed an agent of the Aztec pantheon. Among his victims were a pack of the cartel who had coincidentally started to chase Jake Lockley and Carmen Alcantara (both having bounties on their heads, instated by Culiacan Cartel leader Gilberto Alcantara. He finally attacked Alcantara's villa, slaughtering all guards (and even the dogs). Alcantara hid in office, until Moon Knight came and defeated his last man. Toltec then revealed himself, hidden on the ceiling. Both vigilantes faced each other, and Moon Knight left Toltec deal with the Cartel boss.
weapons: He used a blade, but allegedly never guns.

tom danger.name: Tom Danger
tom danger.origin: Born in 1927, Tom and Wally Danger were twins born the brilliant Dr. Danger, a man who developed a serum that would boost a living organism to their peak physical capacity. He injected his children with this formula just days before he and his wife were killed in a car crash orchestrated by the criminal scientist Doctor Klutch who sought the formula. Orphaned, the Danger twins were to adopted by their father's colleague Professor Moxon; however, Tom was kidnapped by the criminal Wong Chee, leaving only Wally in Moxon's care. Over the years, Tom was trained by Wong Chee to be a professional thief and a good brawler, focusing little on an actual education. Fate reunited the Danger brothers in 1941 on their 14th birthdays. Wong Chee ordered Tom to go and rob someone and bring all the loot back to him. When Wong Chee refused to give the boy a cut of the profit, Tom beat him senseless and left. Coming across Professor Moxon's home, Tom broke in an attempt to rob it. Spotted by Moxon, he was confused for his twin brother and played along. Surprised to see such a great party being thrown, Tom indulged until a local high school football player attempted to cut in on his dance with a girl. This let to a confrontation ending with Tom beating the player senseless. By this time, Wally had returned home after a narrow escape from Wong Chee (who mistook him for Tom). Realizing that Tom was Wally's long lost twin, Moxon invited the boy into their home. Wally promised to help Tom catch up on his education, regularly correcting his poor phonetics and grammar while Tom agreed to teach Wally how to scrap. Happy to have the two boys back together again, Moxon had them enrolled at Westfield High school. On their first day of freshman year, both were approached and bullied by fellow student Derrick Dawes, but Tom came to Wally's defense. With the fight broken up by a professor, the twins went for oral examinations, and while Wally posed as Tom to pass the test, Tom -- posing as Wally beat Dawes in a fight, making the pair fast friends afterward. Both the Danger brothers joined the school football team along with Dawes, the stocky Butch, and the Native American named Eagle. After a number of football victories, they decided to chum together and dub themselves the Tough Kid Squad. Following their victory against Bark Ridge High, Wally and Tom's past came back to haunt them in the form of Dr. Klutch who captured the entire gang. Klutch intended to extract the blood from the Danger brothers to use to empower himself. Taking the boys back to his hideout, he experimented on Wally and Tom and drew blood from Wally after confirming that the serum was in their bodies. They were freed by the rest of the Tough Kid Squad and fled, but not before being forced to slay Klutch's bodyguard Komba who had been injected with Wally's blood. Captured by Klutch again, the group was taken to another of Klutch's hideout where blood was taken from Tom. Injecting himself, Klutch sent the boys to their death in the "Vault of Oblivion" with its crushing roof. Digging their way out, the Tough Kid Squad went after Klutch and his henchmen after they pulled off three successful bank robberies at once. Wally and Tom fought Klutch on their own, knocking the mad scientist out with knock-out gas. Klutch and his gang were soon be arrested by the authorities. Tom's subsequent activities are unrelieved.

tom denver.name: Tom Denver
tom denver.origin: Tom Denver was the friend of John Hargate, the son of millionaire George Hargate. After having laid eyes on the Blooded Ruby of Chung, that the wealthy Hargate had acquired after it had been stolen from the Temple of Chung, Tom was struck by the curse that made him greedy to the point of killing his friend John. Then Hargate hired Dakor to recover the ruby ​​and return it to the Temple. Meanwhile Tom had enlisted in the French Foreign Legion compelling Dakor to joins himself up in order to reclaim the ruby. When Dakor attempts to steal the ruby, he is caught and locked in the brig. However the prisoner are let free when the camp is attacked by a Tuareg Tribe. When Denver attempts to escape, Dakor chases after him and the two are captured. When Dakor demands that the ruby ​​be handed over, his demands are overheard by one of the Tuaregs who informs his leader. Wanting the jewel for himself, the leader threatens to execute Denver if he refuses to reveal the jewel, however Dakor uses his magical powers to escape and save Denver's life. Using his telepathic powers to pluck the hidden location of the gem from Denver's mind, Dakor recovers it and takes it back to the Temple of Chung where he returns it to the idol it was stolen from.

tom douglas.name: Tom Douglas
tom douglas.origin: Tom Douglas was a lawyer living in Newton City, Delaware, in the first half of the 20th century; and was political rival with Daniel "Dan" Reardon. In early 1941, Douglas became the District Attorney, with the covert support of local crimelord Big Tim Skelly. Douglas, being a honest man, opposed organized crime and was acclaimed by the citizens. When Douglas came to suspect that Skelly had a deal with the city's underworld czar Heinie Myers, Myers went to see Skelly about that, complaining that Douglas had only become D.A. thanks to Skelly. Skelly agreed to take care of increasingly-popular Douglas. After Douglas apprehended a drug ring, Skelly sent several hired murderers to kill Reardon and frame Douglas by leaving Douglas' gun in the crime scene, and blood-stained gloves in Douglas' home. To the shock of his million fans, Douglas was arrested, and Skelly planned to push buttons to have him executed. However, while Douglas was in his cell, he was visited by superhuman adventurer the Vision, who appeared through the smoke in Douglas’ cigar. The Vision believed Douglas was innocent and wanted to find the real criminals. The Vision later found the hired murderers and intimidated them to confess the crime and identify their employer. The Vision went after Skelly and Myers, leading to Myers' accidental death when Skelly tried to shoot the Vision. As the Vision promptly vanished, the Newton City Police Department promptly arrested Skelly for Myer's homicide, but was later charged with Reardon's death too. Douglas was vindicated and released, and thus, with Vision help, unseat Skelly.

tom fagan.name: Tom Fagan
tom fagan.origin: Tom Fagan was the organizer of the annual in Rutland, Vermont, an annual parade celebrating Halloween with a super-hero theme with intricate costumes and floats based on popular super-heroes. Given the nature of the parade, and Rutland's mystical connections, Fagan would frequently interact with many super-heroes. His first such encounter happened when he invited the Avengers to participate in the 11th Annual parade. The heroes made an appearance. However they were attacked by by both the Masters of Evil and the Lady Liberators, a group of female Avengers tricked into turning against their male comrades by The Enchantress disguised as Valkyrie. The following year, Fagan chose to not invite superheroes, instead simply asking the locals to cosplay as these. Previous year attendees Roy and Jean Thomas came back and asked Fagan about local legends surrounding Bald Mountain. The Thomases were both impressed and aghast at the creepy details provided by Fagan. When preparing for a later Halloween party, Tom's hospitality was exploited by Loki. Fagan unwittingly invited Loki in and the god of Mischief repaid him by putting Tom into his thrall. Loki then used Tom's home as a staging ground for a plot to use the The Absorbing Man against his stepbrother Thor, who foiled this plot. Later, Tom along with his party guests (all prominent comic book writers and artists) also got caught up in the Beast's battle against the Juggernaut, the latter of the two seemingly dying at the battle's end. When Mantis detected trouble in Rutland, she convinced the Avengers to go investigate. This was a trap set by the Collector who was posing as Fagan during the 14th Annual parade in an another attempt to collect the Avengers. When Mantis and Swordsman revealed the truth and with the help of the real Tom Fagan (who had been captured, bound, gagged and left in the woods). The Avengers defeated the Collector. Following this battle, the Avengers left Loki (who at the time was in a mindless state) in the care of Tom Fagan. Loki soon regained his facilities and used his magic to make it appear that a parade attendee named Bunker was really the mindless Loki. When Bunker's identity was revealed, Tom was briefly held on kidnapping charges until he was able to make a call to the Avengers, and Iron Man was able to clear matters up with the authorities. Tom's subsequent activities are unrevealed. The annual Halloween parade, however, endures. One year, Banshee and Husk took young Artie Maddicks, Franklin Richards, and Leech to the parade.
abilities: Tom was skilled at organizing the annual Rutland Halloween Parade for years. He had great networking skills.

fields.notes: Based on a real life character, Tom Fagan (1932-2008) a writer that began organizing the annual Halloween parade in Rutland Vermond in the 1950s. Taking on a super-hero theme in the 1970s, his parade gained popularity through promotion in Marvel and DC publications, and would be featured in a number of stories. Although later years he was uninvolved with the parade, he was on the panel of judges in 2006, and 2007. He was slated to attend the 2008 parade, however he passed away on October 26, 2008 at age 76. Tom Fagan and his parade has some notoriety as the first (albeit unofficial) Marvel and DC crossover. The stories featured in , and DC's all happen on the same night. Tom was known for dressing up as Batman, as such when depicted in costume in Marvel Comics, he would be depicted as wearing a Nighthawk costume, as Nighthawk was originally a spoof on Batman.

tom garrett.name: Tom Garrett
tom garrett.origin: "Terrible Tom" Garrett was a mob leader who was active during the 1940s. By 1945, Garrett and his gang were pursued by Captain America and Bucky. When the two heroes found Garrett's hideout, they were occupied with fighting Garrett's gang. Garrett himself was able to escape the scene in a stolen car. When the car ran out of gas outside of town and Tom found himself caught in a rain storm, he sought refuge in a nearby home. Inside he was greeted by the evil sorcerer Terdu who offered Tom the means to destroy Captain America once and for all. Terdu then used his magic cauldron to summon Captain Kidd, Jack the Ripper, Jess & Frank James, Bludebear and Jip-the-Blood to the present. Leading this group of Masters of Evil, Tom started a crime spree in order to lure Captain America out into the open. When Cap and Bucky appeared to stop a bank robbery, they were easily captured by the Masters and brought back to Terdu's home. There Terdu demanded that they fight to the finish. During the course of the battle Terdu returned his minions when they failed to stop Cap, and Terdu stumbled into his own cauldron, apparently dying. With his gang defeated, Tom then surrendered to Captain America. His subsequent fate is unknown.

weapons: Tom was armed with a pistol.

tom hale.origin: 200px|thumb|left|Tom "Tubs" Hale and Nancy Brown (Earth-616)|Nancy "Nan" Brown ===Origin=== Tom "Tubs" Hale was raised in Centerville, California. During his adolescence, Tubs became friends with Patsy Walker, Hedy Wolfe, and their gang of friends, and therefore became fictionalized as one of the characters in Dorothy Walker's comic book series that was loosely based on Patsy's life. He eventually began dating Patsy's friend Nancy "Nan" Brown and took her to the big dance. ===Modern Age=== Tubs and Nan eventually married and had at least two children. The pair continued to reside in Centerville, where Tubs became a clerk at Krautmann's Sodas. Tubs was among the Centervillians to be possessed by Demons under the control of the Sons of the Serpent. 200px|thumb|left|Tom "Tubs" Hale reconnecting with Patricia Walker (Earth-616)|Patsy Walker Sometime later, Tom abandoned the nickname "Tubs", came out, presumably divorced Nan, and moved to New York City. When Hedy Wolfe gained the rights to and began republishing the classic Patsy Walker comics, she gave Tom and others royalties for their likenesses. Using these funds, Tom opened Burly Books, a bookstore in Brooklyn. When Tom and Patsy reconnected by chance, they quickly rekindled their friendship. Tom also hired Patsy's new telekinetic roommate, Ian Soo.

tom hendricks.name: Tom Hendricks
tom hendricks.origin: Tom Hendricks was an inventor who in 1936 married Lolita Dale, a model who was renown for her modelling for paintings of the goddess Diana. Eventually, Lolita squandered Hendrick's fortune and left him, and unknown to him lost her beauty due to some unknown illness. She started up a model photography agency called Super-Studio, charging models $1000 for photo shoots that would eventually be paid back. However, she and her assistant Hogy decided to murder the models before they had to pay them back. By 1946, their plan came to fruition as Tom Hendricks had gone completely insane, and not recognizing his ex-wife was easily manipulated to kill the models to Lolita and Hogy's ends. They convinced him to formula his "Diana" plan, creating spider suits that fired webs so that he could kill models who were either named Diana or the first letter of the names of successive victims spelled out the name "Diana". The murders stumped police and attracted the attention of Betty Dean and the Sub-Mariner. Eventually, after another death, they deduced the connection between "Diana" and Tom Hendricks. When Namor travelled to Hendrick's Catalina home and began questioning him, Hendricks seemingly shot the hero dead and buried him alive and then rushed off to his hideout, unaware that he was leading the Sub-Mariner along the way. There, he attacked Hendricks and Hogy but was knocked out by Lolita. Hendricks then put on one of his spider suits to kill the next victim, leaving Hogy and Lolita to dispose of the Sub-Mariner. They let slip part of their plan in the scheme and left Namor to die by gas, but the hero managed to free himself with the help of Betty. Rushing back to Long Beach, Namor prevented the death of the next model and easily subdued Tom. Learning about the connection to Super-Studio, Namor then rounded up Lolita and Hogy. At the police station, Lolita revealed her true identity to Hendricks who was happy to learn that his hated ex-wife was going to share the same fate as him. This fate, whatever it may be, is unknown.
weaknesses: Hendricks suffered a mental breakdown caused by the loss of his fortune and the departure of his ex-wife. He was homicidally insane.

tom jonson.name: Tom Jonson
tom jonson.origin: In 2095 Tom Jonson and his partner Hank Jordan were overseeing robots they were using to create an underground city called Project X-36. Halfway through construction, the robots all broke down. Tom cursed the robots, saying he hated all robots and wanted to destroy them. The partners were convinced their firm was going to become broke because of the failure, when suddenly atomic oil began to rain from the sky. The source of the oil rain was a strange electrically-charged planet passing above Earth. Tom decided to take a ship up to the planet to investigate and see if they could obtain a source of the oil that could be used for profit. As he approached it, he noted that the planet was green and littered with exploding pools of oil. On his descent, his ship flipped over and he hit his head, rendering him unconscious. He drifted in and out of delirium for awhile as he was saved by the planet's inhabitants, who studied him with telepathy and nursed him back to health. Once he was healthy, Tom tried to strike a bargain with the aliens so that they could all profit from the oil pools on the planet. The aliens argued that couldn't waste the oil because it was their "staff of life." After Tom insisted, the aliens suggested that he went see a pool for himself before deciding anything. Seeing the logic in the suggestion, Tom set off with two guides to investigate an oil pool. When they arrived at one, Tom got too close to the edge against the warnings of one of his guides, Azka. The oil formed into arms and began to pull him into the oil pool. The other guide jumped into the oil and saved him at the cost of his own life. Azka then revealed that their entire race were robots. Tom realized that's why they needed the oil to survive. Once they returned to the other inhabitants, Tom again tried to strike a deal on the oil. The alien robots realized that he only cared about profits, and exiled him back to Earth.

fields.history: In 2095 Tom Jonson and his partner Hank Jordan were overseeing robots they were using to create an underground city called Project X-36. Halfway through construction, the robots all broke down. Tom cursed the robots, saying he hated all robots and wanted to destroy them. The partners were convinced their firm was going to become broke because of the failure, when suddenly atomic oil began to rain from the sky. The source of the oil rain was a strange electrically-charged planet passing above Earth. Tom decided to take a ship up to the planet to investigate and see if they could obtain a source of the oil that could be used for profit. As he approached it, he noted that the planet was green and littered with exploding pools of oil. On his descent, his ship flipped over and he hit his head, rendering him unconscious. tom logan.name: Tom Logan
tom logan.origin: Tom Logan thought of Jasper McReedy as a chemist who took his job too seriously. He also said that Jasper spent all his free time in his basement lab experimenting with secret serums, hoping to create a substance that would cure the world's ills. He also thought that even though Jasper's intentions were honorable, he had lost touch with reality. One day Tom bought a lemonade made by Jasper's daughter, not knowing that she had put Jasper's weight control potion in it thinking it was vitamins. He took a sip of the lemonade and immediately felt strange, so he gave the rest of the lemonade to his dog. The next day, when he was getting dressed, he noticed that the shirt he was wearing was very large and immediately blamed the dry cleaners who had surely given him someone else's clothes but even his dog, usually very thin, could no longer make him wear his harness.

tom metellus.name: Tom Metellus
tom metellus.origin: Dr. Metallus was a engineer for the Sentinel program based in Chicago. He had a hatred of mutants that bordered on fanatical to the point where he watched video tapes of mutants being slaughtered by Sentinels. His wife Lisa left him over his perversion, stating that in a goodbye note that he was "no longer the man" she married. When the mutant group the Morlocks invaded the Sentinel command, the Sentinels tried to attack them but only ended up destroying the base in the crossfire. Metellus managed to stab Postman in the shoulder but was then knocked unconscious by Shatter. When Metallus regained consciousness, he was confronted by Cell who wrapped his body around Metallus and had a Sentinel blast them both, killing Metallus as punishment for the deaths of mutants on his hands, though it resulted in Cell's death as well.

Later, Tom heard his father talk about the rush to buy Geiger counters to detect uranium, and in secret from his father he made an agreement with his boss and had a Geiger counter delivered to his grandfather in the woods. tom morton.name: Tom Morton
tom morton.first_appearance: Strange Tales of the Unusual Vol 1 1
tom morton.origin: Tom Morton embarked as a young man and traveled for 10 years, visiting many places in the world. Returning home, he was hosted by his brother Jack and his family, composed by his wife Ellen and their five years old son, Johnny, on the condition that he would tell them about his travels and adventures. When they asked him which place had impressed him the most, he replied that it was India where he met people capable of doing things bordering on magic. At the end of the story, his brother Jack told him that they too had a little magician at home, that is, little Johnny who, just by thinking of him, was able to make his toy train follow him wherever he went. Tom's disbelief almost led to annoyance, and even after verifying the veracity of Johnny's abilities he convinced the little boy that it was not possible that he could make an inanimate object obey him, and with tears in his eyes Johnny kicked the toy train who no longer obeyed him. At that point Tom decided that he had to return to India.

tom powers.name: Tom Powers
tom powers.origin: Tom Powers was a newspaper reporter who worked for the Free Press newspaper that saw distribution in the American city of Jimtown during the 1940s. At the height of his career, he was considered an outstanding character in the newspaper circles. A staunch believer in freedom of the press, he was courageous and fearless in finding the news. During his career, he would earn the dismay of Detective Clancey Mullaney who would be upset that Powers would often take the law in his own hands -- or obstruct justice in order to crack a case for the sake of making the news. In his only recorded adventure, Powers and his colleague photographer "Candid" Kenny Roberts, known together as the Gruesome Twosome, were assigned by their editor Cupid "Kewpie" Cueball to cover a recent robbery of an armored truck. At the scene of the crime, they found a discarded gas mask and gloves from one of the thieves. They attempted to sneak off with the evidence to get an exclusive scoop when they were spotted by Detective Mullaney. Mullaney convinced Powers and Roberts to work with him. They took the evidence to a police scientist who compiled enough evidence for them to connect the gloves and mask to "Muscles" Moe. Tracking Moe to his hideout, Powers, Roberts, and Mullaney were shocked to learn that the theft was organized by P.J. Organ, the owner of the bank whose armored car was robbed. In a climactic fight, Roberts and the others overpowered Organ and his gang and recovered the stolen loot. With Organ and the mobsters turned over to the authorities, Powers then called in the story to the Free Press.
abilities: Tom Powers was a skilled reporter.

tom preston.name: Tom Preston
tom preston.origin: Bile was a carrier of an unknown number of lethal or debilitating diseases. He was a member of the second Omega Flight. He did not appear to care greatly for human life as he dispensed death without hesitation. Omega Flight was later used by the Master of the World against Alpha Flight after he had tired Alpha Flight out by manipulating them into facing the Hardliners. During the battle, the Master of the World grew frustrated and attempted to kill both Alpha and Omega Flight, but his effort was disrupted when Sasquatch threw Sinew at him. This disruption allowed Alpha Flight to rally for a period and defeat Omega Flight and, eventually, the Master. Years later, Bile was killed in an explosion, orchestrated by a sentient virus from the Microverse that decided to kill everyone with the power to control diseases.
