tom rosetta.name: Tom Rosetta
tom rosetta.origin: The insane reality-warping mutant Mad Jim Jaspers took over the government of the Great Britain of Earth-238. Mad Jim Jaspers then began persecuting other costumed and paranormal individuals, having them hunted down and executed in order to make Britain a safer place to live. Tom Rosetta was one of those targeted by the new regime. After they became outlawed fugitives, Rosetta joined the fight against the oppressive regime running Britain and was among the group that were hiding in a secret location when the Fury attacked and began slaughtering everyone there. Rosetta was supposedly indestructible, but the Fury roasted him alive. Other people slaughtered by the Fury are, Kid Miracleman, Iron Tallon, Bash Street Bunty, the Crusader, Gaath, the Puppetman, Captain Roy Risk, the Arachnid, Android Andy, Miracleman, Colonel Tusker, and Young Miracleman. Captain UK was the only surviving hero on that day thanks to her husband, Rick, sending her away in a Ghost Box. His remains were buried in a superhero graveyard, and years later, Captain Britain passed by his tombstone.
powers: No known paranormal ability

toma zaslon.name: Toma Zaslon
toma zaslon.origin: Toma Zaslon was a general in the Russian Army. She opposed the mutant camps run by S.I.C.K.L.E. because she was secretly a mutant herself. General Zaslon was additionally directing the Titanium Man Mutant-Defense Project. Because she was the highest-ranking general opposing mutant camps, S.I.C.K.L.E. targeted her for assassination. They arranged the escape of Omega Red from the Stranniy Corrective Labor Camp and forced him to go after Zaslon since they had injected him with nanobots that could cause him pain. Weapon X attempted to stop Omega Red's escape, but the villain escaped with Sabretooth in tow. Sabretooth tried to convince Omega Red to fight off S.I.C.K.K.L.E.'s influence, but since he had no choice, he attacked Zaslon during a test of the Titanium Men. Omega Red expressed his regret and lack of choice in killing her, but Weapon X intervened before he could do so. Using her mutant powers, Zaslon raised a barrier of ice to keep her soldiers at bay in order to confront Omega Red without exposing her secret. Sabretooth stepped in and convinced General Zaslon and Omega Red to work together to take down S.I.C.K.L.E.. General Zaslon infiltrated the S.I.C.K.L.E. Mothercarrier and waited in one of the station's escape pods while Omega Red confronted Director Rossovich. When he attempted to escape, Rossovich stumbled into General Zaslon. After she revealed her nature as a mutant, she used a blast of ice to throw him out of the Mothercarrier and to his death. In the meantime, the Winter Guard had engaged Weapon X. Having appointed herself as the new director of S.I.C.K.L.E., General Zaslon declared the mutant foreigners to be friends of Russia and ordered the Winter Guard to stand down. Afterwards, she gifted Weapon X with a transport.

tomar.name: Tomar
tomar.origin: King Tomar was an Hyperborean warlord and an ambitious under-king. He was a long-time enemy of King Brian of Brythunia, and was known as a fierce fighter having sent countless warriors to their end. He married Kormlada, though he treated her harshly. Tomar entered into a border war with King Brian, to the south, possibly partially to give his war-god Borri the battles he needed to feed on, or else the god would perish. He sent Kormlada, with an offer to Malachi, the commander of the Brythunian Cavalry: In exchange for great riches, he would hold back his horsemen away from the battle. Malachi and Kormlada became lovers. Kormlada intended to slay Tomar once the Brythunians defeated, and set up Malachi as her puppet king. The two armies met at Ravenplain. Unlike King Brian who remained in his tent, Tomar led his troops on the battlefield against the Brythunians, in a savage battle opposing two armies of twenty thousand men. Conan participated to the battle, having joined the Brythunians after his escape from the Hyperborean prisons, and slew his jailer in the battle. Some days later, when Squirrel Girl was fighting Hippo at the campus bank, Chipmunk Hunk and Koi Boi intervened. After Doreen's roommate Nancy recognized Chipmunk Hunk, he revealed that he was actually Tomas. tomazooma manidoog.name: Tomazooma (Manidoog)
tomazooma manidoog.origin: Tomazooma is the god of kinship and storytelling of the Manidoog, the Native American gods. He came to be revered primarily by the Keewazi Tribe of Oklahoma. thumb|left|Tomazooma at the Council of Godheads When the Third Host of Celestials descended upon Earth in 1000 AD, both Tomazooma and Gitche Manitou attended a Council of Godheads meeting as representatives of the Manidoog to discuss the threat. In modern times, the Red Star Oil Company constructed a robot in the form of Tomazooma to scare the Keewazi Tribe into forfeiting their oil-rich territory in Oklahoma. Later, this same robot appeared in Carefree, Arizona, where it terrorized local workmen at an oil field. The Tomazooma robot was eventually destroyed following a brief battle with Nova. Captain America suggested that the Roxxon Energy Corporation had sent Tomazooma in order to scare locals into negotiating a land deal.

tombalo.name: Tombalo
tombalo.origin: Tombalo is an alien from the planet Uranos, a world unique to Earth-5106 a reality where space travel and exploration blossomed in the 1950s. He was an expert in "Electro Science" who went insane by the year 2000. He developed a weapon called an "Electro Arc" which erected a powerful force field in space that could disintegrate rocket ships. He then used the weapon to threaten the Galaxy council who in turn assigned Space Squadron field commander Jet Dixon to end his threat. With the aid of Space Squadron science officer LLA 38, Dixon created a device that would cause the Electro Arc to feed back on Tombalo. Tracking Tombalo down, Jet and LLA used the device on his ship causing enough feedback that killed Tombalo in the process, ending his threat.
weapons: Tombalo used an "Electro Arc" which erected a powerful force field in space that could disintegrate rocket ships.

tommie boyd.name: Tommie Boyd
tommie boyd.origin: Tommie Boyd was a scrappy young girl who lived in the impoverished neighborhoods of Yancy Street in New York City. Her constant fighting earned her the nickname "Two-Fisted" Tommie Boyd. She later went on to lead an ethnically diverse incarnation of the Yancy Street Gang. When young drug addicts were going missing on Yancy Street, the gang grudgingly joined up with hated former member, the Fantastic Four's Thing to learn who was taking the addicts and why. Their investigation took them to an abandoned warehouse where they discovered the Fantastic Four's long time foe Dr. Doom was experimenting on the youths in order to develop a cure for drug addiction, however to date the experiments proved fatal. While the Thing battled Dr. Doom, the gang rescued his latest victim Jimmy Sokolowski, and they escaped just moments before Doom set the warehouse to explode. Later, the gang became prime suspects in the murder of young runaway Alison Gaulthing. The gang, having only witnessed the murder, were on the run from the authorities. When the Childwatch Organization hired the young hero named Justice to apprehend them. With the help of the Thing, Justice convinced the Yancy Street Gang to turn themselves in. Realizing that they were only witnesses to the murder, the gang was released from police custody. Later, the gang was involved in a brawl with the rival Nomads gang. The fight was later interrupted when a malfunctioning Doombot went on a rampage on Yancy Street, sending the Yancy Street and Nomad gangs fleeing. The Doombot was eventually taken down by the NYPD's Code: Blue division. Boyd and the members of her version of the Yancy Street Gang have not been seen since, their subsequent fate is unknown.

tommy murdock.name: Tommy Murdock
tommy murdock.origin: ===Early Life=== Thomas "Tommy" Murdock was an Irish immigrant who moved from Ireland to Hell's Kitchen, New York City, in the 1820s. He settled in a neighbourhood rife with gang warfare. In 1822, he joined the Roach Guards, a group of Irish immigrants formed to fight the anti-immigrant gang known as the Bowery Boys. Later, they created their own faction, the Dead Rabbits. Though a criminal, Tommy was a devout Catholic and regularly attended Mass at St. Matthew's Church. ===The Blind One=== On November 11th, 1835, he met with Father Emmett as he and his gang protected Irish churchgoers. However, the Bowery Boys arrived, confronting them in the streets. As the two groups prepared for battle, a Native American woman observed them from the shadows. Tommy soon learned that people in the area were being murdered, their bodies left with pieces of flesh missing. Seeking answers, he and his old gang encountered the Native American woman revealing her name to be Soena'hane'e. She revealed that the settlers had built their church on tainted land. Leading them to the church, she uncovered a hidden passageway descending into the earth. Deep below, Father Emmett stood before a pagan altar, revealing his true purpose. He had been waiting for Tommy, intending to sacrifice him to the demonic entity known as the Blind One. The priest and his followers had been sacrificing local Irishmen in an effort to summon the demon. Tommy fought back despite being stabbed, refusing to become their final offering. As the Blind One began to emerge into the earthly realm, Tommy seized the priest's knife and struck. Meanwhile, Soena’hane’e attacked the rising demon. In a final act of defiance, Tommy grabbed a rock and shattered the altar, killing the priest and sealing the demon’s passage. The tomb collapsed around him, and he perished, making the ultimate sacrifice. ===Matt Murdock=== For two centuries, Tommy's soul remained trapped in Purgatory. Eventually, he encountered his descendant, Matt Murdock, who had willingly sacrificed himself to stop the demon’s resurgence. Recognising their shared lineage, Tommy expressed his pride in Matt before they found themselves seated at a table with a mysterious fish-like figure. Before them lay seven cups, each representing a different path tied to Matt’s past, present, and future. Six promised a form of bliss, while the seventh, concealed beneath a cover, held either ultimate joy or unimaginable suffering. The only way forward was to make a choice. fields.history: ===Early Life=== Thomas "Tommy" Murdock was an Irish immigrant who moved from Ireland to Hell's Kitchen, New York City, in the 1820s. He settled in a neighbourhood rife with gang warfare. In 1822, he joined the Roach Guards, a group of Irish immigrants formed to fight the anti-immigrant gang known as the Bowery Boys. Later, they created their own faction, the Dead Rabbits. Though a criminal, Tommy was a devout Catholic and regularly attended Mass at St. Matthew's Church. ===The Blind One=== On November 11th, 1835, he met with Father Emmett as he and his gang protected Irish churchgoers. However, the Bowery Boys arrived, confronting them in the streets. As the two groups prepared for battle, a Native American woman observed them from the shadows. Tommy soon learned that people in the area were being murdered, their bodies left with pieces of flesh missing. Seeking answers, he and his old gang encountered the Native American woman revealing her name to be Soena'hane'e. She revealed that the settlers had built their church on tainted land. Leading them to the church, she uncovered a hidden passageway descending into the earth. Deep below, Father Emmett stood before a pagan altar, revealing his true purpose. He had been waiting for Tommy, intending to sacrifice him to the demonic entity known as the Blind One. The priest and his followers had been sacrificing local Irishmen in an effort to summon the demon. Tommy fought back despite being stabbed, refusing to become their final offering. As the Blind One began to emerge into the earthly realm, Tommy seized the priest's knife and struck. Meanwhile, Soena’hane’e attacked the rising demon. In a final act of defiance, Tommy grabbed a rock and shattered the altar, killing the priest and sealing the demon’s passage. The tomb collapsed around him, and he perished, making the ultimate sacrifice. ===Matt Murdock=== For two centuries, Tommy's soul remained trapped in Purgatory. tommy pidgeon.origin: Tommy Pidgeon together with his friends wanted to prepare a welcome party for Tommy's Uncle Pete, since he had always been affable and helpful with the boys. Pete had been away on business for a long time, not knowing what kind of work Pete did anyway. Tommy's parents, however, did not agree to the party, telling the boys that Pete would be very tired when he returned and it was better to wait at least a few days. When the limousine that took Pete home arrived the boys were present and noticed that Pete was floating when he got out of the car, so they understood that Pete was an astronaut and had returned from Outer Space and therefore had to readjust to Earth's gravity. Seeing this, the boys and Tommy's parents still organized the welcome party using a trapeze that was in the barn where Pete could lean.

tommy roark.name: Tommy Roark
tommy roark.origin: Coming across a wanted poster offering a $5000 reward for his capture dead or alive, Ringo Kid just barely avoids getting his head blown off by a young boy with a rifle. Realizing he has missed his shot, the young lad is frightened by the Ringo Kid, but soon realizes that the famous outlaw is not as bad as the wanted posters make him out to be. Asking the young boy why he was after the reward on his head, the Ringo Kid learns that the lad -- named Tommy Roark -- comes from a poor family and his mother is deathly ill and they need the money for medicine. The Ringo Kid rides the boy home and they are shocked to find the Roark ranch on fire. The Ringo Kid rushes in and rescues Tommy's father and mother. After treating their wounds, the Ringo Kid learns that the fire was lit by a man named Baxter. The elder Roark explains to the Ringo Kid that Baxter loaned him money and mortgaged his property after his cattle was rustled and then after he purchased new cattle this herd was stolen as well. When Baxter came to collect his money, Roark refused to leave his home and that was when Baxter, finding the land more valuable than the house built on it, set the home ablaze. The Ringo Kid then decides to pay Baxter a visit and rides away unaware that his quarry and his gang have been secretly watching. Baxter tells his men that they are going to handle Roark and his family first then the Ringo Kid and collect the reward on his head. However the Ringo Kid is tipped off by his friend Dull Knife who happened upon Baxter and his men and heard the entire plot. The Ringo Kid then comes up with a plan and rides into town to talk to the local cattle buyer. There he learns that Baxter recently sold some cattle that resemble the ones that were stolen from Roark. The Ringo Kid then rides into town and confronts Baxter and his men in the local saloon and allows himself to be captured. He is quickly brought to trial and locked up with Baxter collecting the $5000 reward on the Kid's head. However, the Ringo Kid is not locked up for long as Dull Knife arrives outside his cell and cuts through the bars and helps the Kid escape. They then return to the saloon to confront Baxter and his men again. The Ringo Kid and Dull Knife easily disarm Baxter and his men and steal the reward money just as the sheriff arrives with evidence given to him by Dull Knife proving that Baxter stole, rebranded and sold cattle stole from Pete Roark. The Ringo Kid then returns to the Roark ranch and turns over the stolen reward money, telling the family they earned it before parting company.

tommy thumb.name: Tommy Thumb
tommy thumb.origin: Tommy Thumb was a midget in Fritz Tiboldt's Circus in the 1940s. When the group was hired by the Nazi party to tour the United States and eliminate key military officials, he was forced to do Tiboldt's bidding through threats and intimidation. Fritz forced Tommy to release a tiger from its cage and set it to maul General Blaine of the U.S. Military. Spotted on the scene by Captain America and Bucky, they failed to capture him. However, Cap and Bucky later dismantled Fritz's operation. Tommy's subsequent fate remains unrevealed, however as Fritz Tibolt would return to Germany and resume his circus, it is possible that Tommy resumed working for Tibolt. As such, it is noteworthy to mention that Tibolt would later be murdered by Nazis who evaded capture in retribution of his failure, it is unknown if Tommy would have met the same fate.
weaknesses: Tommy was easily coerced into following the orders of others through fear, intimidation, and the threat of violence.

tomoe.origin: ===Origins=== Tomoe was a nobody who considered herself to have been reborn after being exposed to the Terrigen Mists spread throughout the world by the Terrigen Bomb. The mists activated her latent Inhuman genes, granting her the ability to control technology with nothing but thought. ===Crimelord=== Using her newfound abilities, Tomoe drove away the different nefarious organizations that preyed on her land, amassing an army of "biohack" ninja in the process, made up of other people she considered to be "disowned and disenfranchised," and successfully seized control of the underworld in Osaka, Japan as the head of the Southeast Asia Crime Syndicate. During her journey to retrieve powerful mystical objects, Madame Masque crossed paths with Tomoe's ninja clan, and made enemies of them. Iron Man first came into contact with the clan when he came across several ninja while investigating Masque's operations, and they tried to murder him to remain in the shadows. thumb|left|Tomoe's Techno Golem Armor After Masque's defeat, Tony Stark enlisted the help of his friend War Machine to find out why were they trailing her. During the investigation, he was abducted by two of them and taken to a warehouse, where he encountered Tomoe. Tomoe used her abilities to strip Rhodes of his armor and don it herself, making it bulkier by additionally using other components from the warehouse. Before she could interrogate and kill Rhodes, Iron Man and Spider-Man appeared on the scene to rescue him; however, she absorbed Stark's armor into her as well, gaining even more power and creating a devastating explosion that seemingly killed Stark. Stark actually survived, but went under the radar and adopted the identity of "Richard Franco," an alleged former Navy SEAL and ex-S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. Under the alias of Franco, Stark made his way through the Japanese underground for weeks until Tomoe took notice of him and enlisted his help in finding War Machine and killing him in order to tie up loose ends. When Rhodes decided to put an end to Tony's undercover operation for his own good, he enlisted the help of the Avengers. The growing presence of superheroes in Osaka worried Tomoe, thinking they had arrived to avenge Tony Stark. The heroes eventually attacked Tomoe's base of operations, disrupting her enterprise; however, Tomoe herself had preemptively escaped. Tomoe eventually reorganized her criminal empire. Having caught notice of Ironheart having taken up the legacy of Tony Stark when he fell into a coma following the second superhuman civil war, she decided to take her down to prevent her operations from being disturbed again. Tomoe proceeded to attack Ironheart and Rescue in Chicago, backed up by an army of ninja and having stripped the heroines of her suits to encase herself in a new armor. Riri managed to slip away to get help while Pepper Potts fended off Tomoe's ninja and tried to stall for time. When Tomoe grew tired of Pepper's shenanigans, she prepared to execute her. The Techno Golem was interrupted by the apparent return of Tony Stark, sporting an Iron Man armor. Tomoe absorbed the suit, only to discover that was nobody inside, and that who confronted her was a digital duplicate of Stark's mind. When Tomoe took control of the armor, the Stark A.I. uploaded a virus into her systems which disrupted her powers, knocking out her ninja in the process. Tomoe emerged from the rubble of her disarmed armor and tried to kill Riri with a sword, she was, however, knocked unconscious by Rescue's remotely-controlled gauntlet. When S.H.I.E.L.D. arrived to the scene shortly afterwards, they apprehended Tomoe. Tomoe later appeared to have escaped custody, and continued operating in the Japanese underworld. She came across Miles Morales, Spider-Man's alter-ego, in Tokyo and arranged a meet-up with him after being impressed by his display of power against Goblin Nation thugs.

tomas aguado.name: Tomás Aguado
tomas aguado.origin: Tomás Aguado, alias Striker, was an international mercenary with superhuman powers. He was recruited to participate in the civil war in San Revilla, a Central American country, through the Advisor, a mysterious person who could have demonic powers, and who intended to motivate San Revilla until it completely self-destructed, apparently with the purpose of defining a way to destroy a country that could be replicated elsewhere, for which he operated with both sides of the war. The Advisor considered it essential to use superhumans in this conflict, so to start he made the anti-government rebel group the Shadows, considered insurgents and terrorists, have an elite parahuman unit that included Striker and another mercenary, Sundance. The Shadows were a ruthless group that operated stealthily, attacking troops and refugees without warning to vanish thanks to Sundance's powers of light amplification. Most rebel soldiers were equipped with standardized high-tech weapons and armor. The Advisor also recruited former Avenger Hawkeye to lead and train the Shadows, tricking him into believing that the U.S. State Department was backing the rebel faction against the fascist government militia. Hawkeye took the job, ensuring that he planned operations to hit resources, not people, and avoiding even killing soldiers. However, unbeknownst to Hawkeye, the Shadows were attacking not only government troops but even civilians with lethal force. The Shadows' escalating attacks, organized from a jungle hideway near Vitidos, and the brutal responses of the government military (also equipped with advanced technology thanks to the Advisor) left field hospitals overflowing and without available resources in dilapidated buildings on the edges of the war zone. The Advisor also recruited superhumans to operate for the government, including Hazzerd and Troubleshooter, two superhuman mercenaries, and the U.S.Agent, another Avenger who believed he was working for the US Commission on Superhuman Affairs to confront rogue terrorists. Meanwhile, photojournalist Luke Bergier traveled to San Revilla with his fiancée Cindy to cover the war, but they had to try to leave the country on a Red Cross flight. While on the government airstrip, the Shadows attacked refugees and troops; Hawkeye was present but apparently this part of the operation was hidden from him. Striker threw Luke and Cindy into a hangar wall, breaking his arm and her neck. Luke was sent to a dilapidated field hospital. Luke's sister, Rebecca Bergier, worked as head of operations for the NGO Worldwatch, investigating human rights causes, and convinced her coworker James Rhodes (secretly the superhero War Machine) to go to San Revilla to help Luke. With access to confidential data from San Revilla and technology to monitor radio traffic in the area, War Machine infiltrated San Revilla and met with Luke. Rhodes recommended that Luke leave the country as soon as possible on a refugee flight, and Luke gave Rhodes his camera to develop the images. One of the photos Rhodes saw appeared to show Hawkeye. Meanwhile, Hawkeye led the Shadows to attack a government fuel dump in Vitidos, causing a raging fire; Rhodes eavesdropped the government's warning and went there in his War Machine armor to try to stop the rebels before they harmed anyone else. tonaja.name: Tonaja
tonaja.origin: Tonaja was a young Inhuman, part of a class prior to exposure to Terrigen Mist, which included Nahrees, Dinu (who Tonaja liked), Woz and Kalikya, her best friend. Tonaja was very afraid of changing in the mists, and confided in her grandmother. After Terrigenesis, though, she became the first Inhuman flier evolved naturally in 30-years. Tonaja chose the alias Archaeopteryx, like the prehistoric bird and, along with Dinu and Nahrees entered in the Royal Guard. Gorgon repeatedly insulted them and assigned ridiculous tasks, such as taking care of Lockjaw. When the army led by Yuri Stalyenko attacked Attilan according to a plan that Maximus devised, and which king Black Bolt already knew beforehand but sought to use in their favor, Tonaja and her companions were assigned to the front line of battle, where she was reunited with her other friends and Kalikya, discovering that she had healing powers. Tonaja tried to ask forgiveness for what she had said after their mutation but this time she was rejected, realizing she had been cruel to her friend. Tonaja and her companions fought until Black Bolt ordered the withdrawal. Tonaja was later chosen among a group of Inhuman exchange students to visit and study on Earth.
powers: Tonaja has wings which allow her to fly.

tongah.name: Tongah
tongah.origin: Tongah was the tribal leader of the Fall People and long-time friend and ally to Ka-Zar. He married Seesha, unaware that she and Ka-Zar had had an affair in the past. He was befallen by a madness possibly caused by the proximity of Vibranium while out hunting with Ka-Zar, which caused Ka-Zar to travel to London to find a scientist who could help combat the illness. During Ka-Zar's absence, Tongah discovered that the Savage Land was being invaded by the Sheenarians. Tongah attacked and killed their commander, for which they demanded Tongah's life. Tongah accompanied Ka-Zar to the Sheenarians' home dimension to prevent further invasions. There, he was captured by the Kramen who syphoned off his life energy, rapidly aging him. Tonga helped Ka-Zar evacuate the Fall People. He then listened the tale of the legendary Chtylok, as told by Mathala.

tongue inhuman.origin: Tongue is an Inhuman student chef and Friends of the Tower. There Ulysses Cain met her when Karnak introduced her to his visit to the Tower. Tongue detected in the boy fear and disgust, so she asked Karnak to remove it from her sight. Later, when Ulysses escaped from his cell after Karnak left him imprisoned in it, Tongue found him trying to escape from the Tower, so he advised him to go back. As Ulysses failed to persuade Tongue to let him in, he tried to escape from her. Tongue went after him and cornered him in the kitchen, so the boy grabbed a bowl full of chilies and threw them into her face saturating the sense of the taste of the cook and thus escaping. . Later, Karnak asked Ulysses to apologize to Tongue.
powers: Tongue's only sense is taste, so refined that it takes the place of all other senses, being able even to savor the emotions.

tony casino.origin: Tony was the brother of mob boss Tommy Casino, who had been killed by the Punisher, Tommy tormented his brother for being a little person throughout their lives despite Tony trying to get him to understand that on the inside he was just like him. After his brother's death alongside many other high-level mob bosses, Tony gathered a gang of other disenfranchised and abused little people and began capturing other mobsters and amputating their legs with the ultimate goal of taking over all organised crime in New York City and having the amputees serve them as slaves. He and his gang were killed by the Punisher and Wolverine, Tony was killed while he was trying to escape down a tunnel, after getting his legs sliced off by Wolverine, when the Punisher dropped a grenade down the shaft, vaporizing him.

tony consiglio.name: Tony Consiglio
tony consiglio.origin: Tony Consiglio was a member of Black Cat's Gang. He recommended his friend Lee Price to Mac Gargan for a transactional job with Tombstone's Gang. The transaction went awry when Tombstone's men refused to turn in payment, and Tony pointed his gun at them. Before they could exchange gunfire, the Venom symbiote arrived at the scene and bonded to Lee. Now transformed into Venom, Lee slaughtered both Tombstone's men and the employees of Black Cat that were accompanying him and Tony. When Lee calmed down, Tony initially suggested taking him to a hospital to be checked out. Upon finding out that Lee's new "suit" was powerful enough to take on heroes like Spider-Man, Tony wondered what their next course of action would be. Having realized the potential of having the symbiote if it was kept a secret, Lee killed Tony.

tony conville.name: Tony Conville
tony conville.origin: Tony Conville worked for a fashion show, who in the summer of 1942 let his greed get the better of him. He got involved with racketeer Big Sutton and came up with an insurance fraud scheme involving the jewels that were going to be put on display for a fashion show. The jewels were to be stolen so that the insurance could be cashed in and split between Conville and Sutton. To this end, Conville hired Boots Connors to replace the model that was to wear the jewels to aid in the theft. However, Boots attempted to blackmail Conville by threatening to expose him with the letters he had written to her about the plan. In order to protect himself, Conville murdered Boots and her roommate and destroyed the damning evidence. This however, did not prevent comic book writer Red Skeleton from trying to solve the case. Conville had Red captured and brought him to Big Sutton to be eliminated. Angry that Conville murdered two women, thus complicating their scheme by getting the authorities even more involved than ever, Sutton decided to eliminate Conville as well. Conville's life was spared thanks to the timely arrival of Skeleton's friend, photographer Deena Drayson. Drayson distracted the mobsters long enough for Red to knock them out. Conville was turned over to the authorities, his fate is unknown.

tony diaz.origin: Tony Diaz was one of the first responders to the Chitauri incident that occurred in New York City. As a souvenir, his fire department kept a Chitauri helmet. Months later, Diaz and some of his friends decided to clean the helmet. Unwillingly, they brushed off a Chitauri bacteria that infected Diaz (and two others), causing him to be able to levitate objects and emit static electricity. Eventually, as Agent Phil Coulson tried to calm him down, Diaz disappeared in a flash of electricity.

tony muscato.name: Tony Muscato
tony muscato.origin: Tony "the Mooch" Muscato was a mobster active in New York City. He kept his own territory and did not invade his rivals', who included Gonzalo "el Martillo" Vega and El Brutale, the first of whom reacted accordingly. Muscato enjoyed the food at penthouse restaurant Gatti's and ate there every Friday. El Brutale wanted to expand his territory. He allied with Dr. Friday, a Haitian voodoo houngan who used Zombie-like Zhambies with guns and bombs to kill El Brutale's rivals, leaving not witnesses. Vega had only heard that this new enemy was a cult coming from the islands, possibly Caribbean Sea. Vega and Muscato met at Gatti's to discuss the attacks, not knowing that Dr. Friday had sent a Zhambie to kill them there. Moon Knight's would-be sidekick Midnight saved the attendees by pushing the Zhambie out the window before the detonation. Upon learning that his enemies Muscato and Vega, had survived and that there were witnesses who had seen the Zhambies, Brutale was very angry and criticized Friday; but Friday insisted that he had more Zhambies who would kill Brutale's enemies quickly. However, as the situation with superheroes escalated, El Brutale shot Dr. Friday dead, and Friday sent a Zhambie after El Brutale (it is unclear whether El Brutale survived).

tony stark 2 0.name: Tony Stark 2.0
tony stark 2 0.origin: Tony Stark 2.0 was the result of the activation of a contingency plan equipped into the Iron Man Armor Model 28 shortly after its creation. If its user was rendered incapacitated or killed while wearing it, the armor would be forced to attempt an emergency upload of their consciousness. The armor's processors had created a beta model of Stark's personality, "Tony Stark 2.0." As he was about to test it, Tony Stark was attacked by a group of mechas known as Beautiful Garbage. Using a rail gun, the armor was pierced and Iron Man was severely injured. While the armor protected an unconscious Stark by activating the combat autopilot option, the emergency uploading protocols were met, and the armor's set of neurofunction scans were merged with the pre-existing Tony Stark 2.0 persona model, working with 79% cognitive integrity. After escaping the mechas, the system control of the armor was transferred to Tony Stark 2.0, who proceeded to remove the real Stark and place him in the wooded area adjacent to Stark Industries, so he could be found by S.H.I.E.L.D. operatives soon in the scene. However, Beautiful Garbage operative Absynthe doctored the fooage of the inciden and sent it to S.H.I.E.L.D., framing Tony 2.0 for the attack on Stark Industries and Stark's severe injury, leading the spy organization to start a hunt for Iron Man 2.0. S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Capekiller unit led by Major Tom Aramaki tried to destroy Iron Man 2.0 in an aerial pursuit, but they failed. During the pursuit, and soon after going under the radar and ditching one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s "Gungir" missiles, Iron Man 2.0 began to see hallucinatory images of a tattooed and pierced woman, who showed the intention of erasing "Tony Stark 2.0" from the armor's systems. To avoid S.H.I.E.L.D.'s attention, Iron Man 2.0 kept going in a "borrowed" car (seemingly of Johnny Storm's propriety). While on the car, Tony 2.0 analysed the entry hole drilled through the edge of the suit's right hand with the rail gun, and discovered said rail gun had been developed by Mecha Underground. Tony 2.0 set out to one of Mecha Underground's underwater parties in order to gather intel and find out who had attacked "Tony 1.0." However, the armor's right hand repulsor suddenly activated, damaging the car and precipitating it and Tony 2.0 to water. Absynthe, a virtual avatar of a virus which was the cause of the error showed herself in Tony 2.0's virtual reality systems. Absynthe stated that she had been uploaded into the armor via deposit by the rail gun round that penetrated it, and was slowly writing herself over the armor's operating code. The avatar soon disappeared, and Iron Man 2.0 continued with his plan of infiltrating the underwater Mecha Underground party, using the armor's camouflage to look like a regular robot. Before he could interrogate the mecha identified as the builder of the rail gun, Iron Man 2.0's cover was blown by Absynthe, who used the armor's disguise display to reveal Tony 2.0's identity. Abysnthe also proceeded to hack the other mechas at the party, and attack him. A S.H.I.E.L.D. Undercover Mech-Intel Operative identified Iron Man, and informed the Capekiller unit of his location. Iron Man 2.0 defeated the Mecha Underground and exfiltrated to the surface, not before having microdrones adhered to his armor's surface by the S.H.I.E.L.D. Mech, which lit him up in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s radar, and projected an ideal target profile to S.H.I.E.L.D.. As he was flying away, the operating systems of Tony 2.0's armor was cracked by Absynthe, who opened up the suit. Absynthe had also cracked Tony 2.0's personality construct and started overwriting his memories and programming code. With Tony 2.0 unable to pilot the suit, it entered in tactical autopilot mode when facing S.H.I.E.L.D.'s firepower. After finally being seemingly deleted by Absynthe, Tony 2.0 revealed that while Absynthe overwrote his memory space, he had simultaneously overwritten himself into her memory space. With access to Absynthe's memories, Tony 2.0 discovered her origin. After gaining control over his armor, Absynthe revealed there were other parts her plan. A group of mechas, the Beautiful Garbage, attacked the Assault Carrier of the Capekillers. Even though he managed to destroy one of the mechs, Iron Man 2.0 had to jack up his cognitive clockspeed to match and surpass that of the mechs. However, the Absynthe downloaded Stark 2.0's accelerationware into the Beautiful Garbage, which run better on their processors. Similarly to the way in which Absynthe had hacked the Mech Underground, Tony wrote additional functions into the accelerationware stolen from him, which turned the remaining Beautiful Garbage into software-parasitized puppets. Tony 2.0 made the mechs destroy each other. During the attack on the carrier, a contingency plan was activated, which consisted in the detonation of a 1.5 megaton thermonuclear warhead. With only 7 seconds left for the detonation, Tony 2.0 managed to crack the carrier's tactic

fields.trivia: Tony Stark 2.0's top 5 positives about not having an organic human body are: The ability to listen to music at volumes ear-damaging for human bodies. tony tipple.name: Tony Tipple
tony tipple.origin: Tony Tipple wanted to have a parakeet, like many of his friends but couldn't afford it. After seeing the evolutions of his friend Toodles Murphy's parakeet, he went home sad but on the way he met a garishly dressed man. Asking him who he was and what he did, the man replied that he was taking a bird census but that of the earphones he used to listen to the birds, one had fallen off and he couldn't find it and the other wasn't working well. After chatting with Tony and giving him some information about birds, the strange man left and soon after Tony found the earpiece that the man had lost. By wearing it he discovered that he really could listen to the birds and understand them to the point of being able to make pigeons listen to him, becoming the envy of the other inhabitants of the town. Thanks to this, Tony became a true expert and scholar of ornithology without anyone knowing that he could really talk to birds.

tony trainer.name: Tony Trainer
tony trainer.origin: Despite the objections of Dr. Marla Madison, Tony Trainer was ordered by Morelle Pharmaceuticals rep Marcus Devane to begin the microwave bombardment of bio-samples from Quicksand and the Sandman as part of Project: Sandstorm. Trainer, more concerned with the excitement of pure science than their bickering, did as he was told. The two microwave-irradiated samples gained contact with each other and created a dual magnetic resonance, resulting in a massive explosion. Encased in an amorphous shell of particles, Trainer ground his way across the Empire State University campus, adding to his mass as he pulverized everything in his path. Spider-Man rescued Dr. Madison from his path of destruction and dropped a wall on him, briefly halting his rampage. As Quicksand and Sandman arrived at the trail of their purloined bio-samples, Trainer emerged in his new humanoid form as Sandstorm. Believing that he'd killed Devane, who had actually been killed in the explosion, Sandstorm generated a massive sand-maelstrom while Spider-Man and Sandman escaped to safety. He briefly battled Quicksand until she claimed that she'd come to help him. Together, they battled Spider-Man and Sandman. Sandstorm disabled Sandman with his sand-spikes, but was rendered powerless when Spider-Man hit him with a chunk of reverse-polarized shrapnel which dispersed his fused-grit armor. As the police took Trainer away, Sandman stayed with him to ensure that he was treated fairly.

tony trent.name: Tony Trent
tony trent.origin: Tony Trent was a bank robber and murderer who, after making a quarter-million dollar heist, was captured and sentenced to death, but not before hiding the loot. However, he managed to escape from death row and during his escape he stumbled upon a shack inhabited by a hermit but who recognized Trent. Agreeing to reveal where the loot was if he helped him in his escape, as soon as he had written the hiding place on a piece of paper Trent was immediately killed by the hermit but on his deathbed Trent cursed him telling him that his face would haunt him until his death. In fact the hermit was killed by the police when he was recovering the loot and his face had become that of Trent.

tooby.name: Tooby
tooby.origin: Tooby was a member of the amphibian race of the Tubanti and was close friends with Matty Plunder, the son of Ka-Zar and Zahmis of the tailed Tree People. These three would regularly play in the jungles of the Savage Land. While they were playing, Zahmis tells her friends that someone had burned the forest, and their friend Rucha replied that her mom had told her that whoever did would plant more trees and produce food, even though her friends didn't believe her and when Tooby asked her where the food was coming from, she replied that his mom had told him it was complicated to explain. The tribe had to abandon their waters due to the oil pollution caused by the Roxxon "Pangean Horizon" oil rig accident. While the tribe tried to be hosted by some other tribe, Tooby happily continued to play with Matthew. Tooby was among the victims of antibiotics supplied by Roxxon of which he was among many of his tribe to be allergic to that drug.

fields.unusual_features: Tooby as any member of his race possess two twin gills located on his neck near the clavicle bone, which allows him to breathe underwater and webbed hands and feet.

tooloo.name: Tooloo
tooloo.origin: Toloo appeared as a short, broad-shouldered man wearing outdated beach clothing, a derby hat, and an oversized tie. He first manifested before Jimmy Binn during the latter’s vacation at a seaside boardwalk, seemingly aware of Jimmy’s private thoughts and insecurities. Though physically unimpressive, Toloo demonstrated extraordinary strength and agility, effortlessly overpowering a group of powerful acrobats who had been bullying beachgoers. His abilities appeared to contradict his frail anatomy, suggesting that his power derived from mental or metaphysical sources rather than physical conditioning. Toloo claimed to embody Jimmy Binn’s own mind and heart, asserting that belief and desire could reshape reality and personal capability. According to his explanation, he existed as a projection of Jimmy’s unrealized potential, appearing only to guide him toward self-confidence and transformation. Following a final conversation in a nearby park, Toloo vanished without explanation, leaving only ambiguous physical evidence of his presence.

tooth.name: Tooth
tooth.origin: Tooth was one of the Dwarves of Nidavellir who helped Tony Stark build the weapons that would be used to oppose the Serpent's Worthy, although he did so with hostility towards Tony. When Tony stumbled on some metal ingots due to drunkenness, Tooth was furious and punched him but Tony reacted by returning the blow, so they made up and toasted all together. In truth, however, Tooth was a traitor working under a Smoke Elf duo that were in league with The Serpent. He'd procured some of Stark's hair so they could fashion an assassin out of it through their magic, all in exchange for joining the winning team. But was lethally silenced by his co-conspirators to ensure the secret remains buried.

top man.name: Top Man
top man.origin: The Top Man was a Maggia leader who bought the Baxter Building to steal the scientific equipment of Mister Fantastic of the Fantastic Four. After purchasing the property, the Top Man posed as the lobby attendant to get a lay of the land. He later delivered an eviction notice to the Fantastic Four in this guise, but the team refused to leave. Arming his men with suits that protected them from harm, he sent them to claim the Baxter Building by force. This led to a clash with the Fantastic Four, who eventually subdued the invaders. When his minion Gimlet almost revealed his identity, the Top Man shot him dead. His claims of coming to the aid of the FF were seen through by Reed Richards who unmasked the Top Man and turned him over to the authorities. Sources state that the courts found the transaction to be invalid and ownership of the Baxter Building was transferred back to Walter Collins. For his failure, the Top Man was killed in jail by a Maggia assassin.

topographical man.name: Topographical Man
topographical man.origin: The Topographical Man is an ancient, enigmatic being whose origins remain unknown. In the 31st century, Nikki, a Mercurian survivor of the Badoon genocide, escaped in her family spaceship. Stranded near the edge of the Solar System, she discovered a derelict ship with a mysteriously deceased crew. She survived aboard it, using it to explore lifeless planets that once supported life. Nikki eventually joined the Guardians of the Galaxy. Together, they uncovered the cause of the planetary death—an entity known as Karanada—and were swallowed by it. Inside, they found themselves on the surface of the Topographical Man, though they initially believed it to be another planet. Vance Astro flew their ship through the being’s surface and confirmed from space that it was a massive humanoid entity. Guided by Starhawk to the Convent of the Living Fire, Nikki underwent the ritual of flame and merged with the Godhead, gaining an immense astral form. Vance Astro, whose essence had also merged with the Topographical Man during the battle with Karanada, joined with Nikki. Their combined will grew to match the scale of the Topographical Man. They embraced him, forcing him to commit an 'act of love'—a concept fundamentally opposed to his nature as the antithesis of life—thereby destroying him.
weaknesses: An act of love of enough magnitude is enough to harm Topographical Man, even destroy him.

tora.name: Tora
tora.origin: The being known as Tora's past is mysterious, and there is little even she knows. She seems to be an android of similar make and model as Jim Hammond, the android who became the original Human Torch. She became aware of her existence immersed in a water fountain in a Japanese garden. Upon exiting the fountain, she burst into flames. She was found by Jim Hammond, who taught her how to control her powers, and the two had many adventures and were continually on the run. Eventually, Tora and Hammond parted company, with Hammond ending his life when he decided that he had no will to live. Through unrevealed circumstances, Tora joined up with Xen, a group of super-heroes under the leadership of Lord Sonfire, that acted as defenders of the Asian continent. She joined her fellow Xen members in traveling to Asgard to help Dr. Strange free Clea from Odin, and later she helped her teammates destroy the reanimated corpse of Fin Fang Foom. Following this adventure, her current whereabouts are presently unknown.

toranos.name: Toranos
toranos.origin: Toranos was an Elder God who was formed during the formation of the Earth by the Demiurge, embodying both the storm and the cycles of fate. Fearing for his life against the Demogorge during his culling of the Elder Gods, he hid away in Utgard, along with his brother Utgard-Loki and three others: Kemur, Mejed, and Nrgl. Gaea, who had been given a key to Utgard later freed him and he went Midgard to attack New York City, where he battled Thor while his siblings watched. Using the Thorforce, Thor was able to blow Toranos through a portal to the Far Shore, sparing the city. Toranos eventually found his way back and tracked Thor to the Gray Area of the Moon. To fight him, Thor shared his power with his allies and reformed the Thor Corps. Thor defeated Toranos by luring him into claiming Mjolnir for its power. When he did so, Thor bestowed upon him "the power to hold the storm back", the compassion Thor had learned through his life. Tortured by his new conscience, Toranos revealed that Gaea and the Utgard-Loki had sent him to destroy humanity before fleeing. thumb|left|Toranos is put out of his misery by Thor After returning to Utgard, now being able to feel compassion thanks to Thor, Toranos spoke with his fellow Utgard-Gods and tried to make them understand his cause and show mercy. However, it was in vain, Toranos was gored and knocked down by Kemur before being nailed to his wheel by Mejed with steel forged by Nrgl, while Utgard-Loki watched, before sending him to Asgard with a message. After Thor appeared before him, Toranos informed him about the returning of the Black Bridge of the River Vimur that gives access to Utgard, before being finished off with a energy beam from Mjolnir in an act of mercy by Thor.
weapons: Toranos carries an immense wooden wheel that he uses as a weapon. He refers to this wheel as the "Wheel of Fate", a concept other deities have referenced. This wheel represents the and cyclical nature of fate, which he embodies. Mjolnir

torg bodyguard.name: Torg (Bodyguard)
torg bodyguard.origin: Torg volunteered to be experimented on by Dirkreich Pharmaceuticals to attain super strength. Something went awry, however, and Torg was transformed into an immobile mass of flesh that couldn't hold himself up. So, Torg had to rely on a large exoskeleton to move about and became a minion of Frederick Dirkreich, Dirkreich Pharmaceuticals' head. When the superhero Tigra snuck into Dirkreich Pharmaceuticals' complex, Torg was ordered to capture by Dirkreich so he could use her to reverse his body's degeneration. Torg, using his exoskeleton, was able to capture Tigra using a knock-out gas. Tigra later escaped, and Torg attempted to kill her, but she knocked Torg out when a kick to the head. His whereabouts afterward are unknown.
powers: None. Instead, they come from his exoskeleton.
weapons: Torg's exoskeleton is equipped with blades, knock-out gas, and a net launcher.
weaknesses: Torg's body became a jellied mass after a failed experiment and can't move on his own without his exoskeleton. Also, while his exoskeleton provides protection from harm, he can be taken down with a strong enough blow to the head.

torg caveman.name: Torg (Caveman)
torg caveman.origin: A caveman from the Vanir tribe where the main hunter came back empty-handed, Torg reprimanded him for his failure and publicly put forward the hunter's replacement with another person - maybe Torg himself. The settlement was then attacked by a mammoth, which was defeated by the bare-handed hunter. The hunter revealed he had been granted powers by "the wise gods", and that the gods were willing to bless the other tribesmen. Torg was speechless at this revelation and demonstration, and joined the tribe in visiting the gods' shrine. However, the gods proceeded to kill all the tribesmen, including Torg, except for the hunter. The hunter was enraged at this and devoted his life to get revenge on the person who murdered Torg and his other peers.
weapons: Spear

torkay.origin: Tor-Kay is an alien who defended Silver Surfer during his trial. In the past her planet was eaten by Galactus being one of the few survivors. After the destruction of his planet he dedicated his life to justice. Surfer was about to stand trial and she agreed to defend him at trial. The trial began and Gamora accused him of being guilty of being responsible for the destruction of planets, but Tor-Kay defended him by stating that Surfer was a victim of Galactus. The trial advanced and Surfer was condemned to die and taken to a destroyed planet full of traps and in that place he lost his powers. Tor-Kay was with Gamora on a ship which would be sucked into a black hole, but Surfer used his powers to turn it into a portal and the ship managed to escape safely.

torkon ii.name: Torkon II
torkon ii.origin: Trokon II was, at least for a very brief time, ruler of the Tribbitites following the rule of Toadius V. He ruled the planet Toadworld alongside his queen Froja. Discovering a world that was transformed by the Shaper of Worlds he ordered his armies to explore the planet. They in turn captured the Hulk as well as two creatures that were transformed to resemble his friends Crackajack Jackson and Jarella. When he learned that the Shaper was involved, he sent his minions back to kidnap the powerful being. Ultimately, the Hulk foiled this plot, freeing the Shaper in the process. The fate of Trokon II is unknown, however Toadius V has later been seen ruling the Tribbities since Trokon's defeat.
weapons: Trokon wore a Mentrialator device that was embedded in his royal crown.

toro rojo.origin: Masquerading as a wrestler, El Toro Rojo assaulted El Vampiro, and inflicted a serious wound. He came after El Vampiro again, but found him protected by Thor. Although he put up a fierce battle against Thor, in the end Thor crushed his horns with Mjolnir, rendering him nearly powerless. In the years that followed, as part of some punishment, Toro was confined to a bull totem. Eventually, this totem was found by Huascar Amaru, who gave it to his son Tupac. When the Amaru farm was attacked by thugs, Toro convinced Tupac to exchange bodies with him. Toro fought bravely for his playmate's family, and killed one of the invaders. He was then approached by Warlord Kro, who had added his name to his Delta Network. Kro needed Toro's aid in rescuing the Avengers from Ghaur in Lemuria. He was sent to rescue the Black Knight and Giant-Man from the Deviant arenas where they were being controlled. Toro fought the controlled Avengers, but in the midst of his clash with the Black Knight, he was forced to exchange bodies with Tupac again until the brain-mine malfunctioned and the Black Knight regained control of himself. The other members of Delta Force protected Tupac until they could leave Lemuria, and their mission had been accomplished.
powers: Possesses and endurance.

fields.unusual_features: Hooves instead of feet and steel bull horns grafted to his skull.

toro suzuki.name: Toro Suzuki
toro suzuki.origin: Toro Suzuki was an assassin for hire who once met Bullseye when both of them were hired to kill the same target. Suzuki was attacked by Punisher while completed the contract. Suzuki joined the efforts of the the Hell Riders, to organize a proper burial for Bullseye when he was killed by Daredevil, believing it was a way to pay an honor debt, and seized Bullseye's corpse from the morgue, hiding from Shroud while doing so. During the funeral, Suzuki attacked one of the tourists kidnapped to act as mourners, and continued atteneding the funeral until it was attacked by Daredevil and the Hand, having been tipped by Ben Urich. Suzuki was defeated and taken to the dungeons in the Shadowland Fortress.

toros skrull.name: Toros (Skrull)
toros skrull.species: Skrull having undergone the Infiltration Ritual (Super-Skrull)
toros skrull.origin: Little is known about "Toros", save that he was a Skrull who has has infiltrated the Inhuman community at Attilan under that identity. Toros befriended young Luna Maximoff and attended a special cathedral mass administered by Karnak where he taught younger attendees the history of Kree/Skrull relations. Later that evening, Toros and Luna returned to the cathedral where they saw Karnak analyzing the body of a dead Skrull who, up until recently, had been masquerading as their former liege Black Bolt. When the two accidentally alerted Karnak to their presence, Toros assumed his true form. After a brief battle, Karnak threw the Skrull out a window killing it when it fell and was impaled on a fence.

torpid.name: Torpid
torpid.origin: Torpid is young Morlock girl, probably between four and eight years old, and somewhat physically small in comparison to other children of similar age. Whether her diminutive size is part of her genetic heritage is unknown. She is also very “cute,” in a certain eerie way. Her only other extraordinary physical feature is her oversized hands, which she keeps concealed under an ever-present pair of black leather gloves, which she removes in order to utilize her mutant power. She does not speak, but communicates by means of facial expressions, indicating she may be mute, although she was heard screaming once. Unlike Rogue’s power, her own may penetrate at least one layer of clothing, the victim’s, to effect her “stun-touch”, thus whether the gloves are a necessity in order to keep her power from activating accidentally or in a manner beyond her control, as with Rogue, is unclear. It could also be that she wears the gloves for the primary purpose of concealing her hands along with the secondary purpose of dampening her power. She was one of the Morlocks to first welcome Evan (Spyke), when he awoke to see the group She has been a great ally to the Morlocks on many occasions, with the use of her “touch” pulling them out of any tight spot or two.
powers: Paralyzing Touch: Torpid can temporarily paralyze anyone by means of touching them using her huge hands. She uses a pair of gloves, so she won't be able to use her powers unless she chooses to do so.
abilities: Innocent Look: Her innocent look as a child may make anyone refuse to hurt her.
weaknesses: Involuntary Activation of Mutant Powers: She has no apparent control over her powers like Rogue and Wither. Mute: She cannot speak like other mutants do. She uses sign languages to give messages to others.

torran.name: Torran
torran.origin: Torran is a member of the Ether Tribe which reside in the Savage Land. It was believed they died out long ago and the stories of them became myth the the people of the Savage Land. Torran is the first Ethereal seen in 4000 years. Torran appears during the meeting of the tribes of the Savage Land gathered by the Zebra People. The tribes present were the Pterons, Aerians, and Reptile Men. He threatened them that they must follow him as a united people or die. Torran ended up battling Ka-Zar, Shanna, and Zabu.

torso wwii.name: Torso (WWII)
torso wwii.origin: The past of the man known as Torso is mostly a mystery. By his own account, he lost his arms and legs in a blast by an American-made shell and spent years recovering in a hospital in utter pain. He spent his recovery hating anything to do with America. Eventually, he decided that he was going to destroy the United States and rule the world. However, he was but one man facing an entire country, and so he decided to create his own master race to enslave mankind. He constructed mechanical arms and legs that replaced his lost ones and developed a lab hidden in a mountainous region within the United States. Calling himself the Torso, he began his life goal by affecting American weapons manufacturing. He had begun planting spies within the Axis powers of Nazi Germany, Imperial Japan, and Fascist Italy. While these world powers learned of the Torso's existence, they were never able to learn his identity or his location. By the summer of 1943, he had sent a letter to Adolf Hitler asking for funding and troops from all the Axis countries in exchange for the destruction of Captain America, their mutual enemy whom the Torso viewed as the only being capable of standing in the way of their goals. Hitler called a meeting with Benito Mussolini and Emperor Hirohito, and they all mutually agreed to help fund the Torso, all were unaware of his own bid for world conquest. The Torso then began capturing scientists and defense officials for twofold purposes: first it would affect the United States ability to produce more weapons, and it would also provide him with test subjects for his new master race. Those who were successfully captured he attempted to fuse with animals, causing horrible abominations, and very few would survive. Learning Captain America's identity, he send the hero a letter, issuing a challenge to Camp Lehigh. Captain America decided to follow the first clue with his partner Bucky to stop the kidnapping of Professor Winters. However, Winters was drugged and went willingly. Captain America and Bucky's trail led through many traps, but they eventually made it to the Torso's secret hideout. There, they were briefly incapacitated by the electrical bolts that the Torso could fire from his hands. They were then told the Torso's life story and his plans for the world. Realizing the Torso needed to be connected to the metal ground to utilize the full electrical output for his energy blasts, Cap lifted him off the ground while Bucky deactivated the dynamo that powered him. Cap then freed the scientists who were not yet experimented on and sent Bucky to free them. While Bucky was gone, Cap fell for the Torso's compassionate plea to be placed at his desk -- citing that his mechanical implants were hurting him -- this gave the Torso the opportunity to plug the portable dynamo into his artificial limbs and jolt Captain America. When Bucky returned, the Torso grabbed the youth and escaped out a secret elevator to the mountains outside his base. He climbed the cliff side with Bucky as his prisoner. When Cap came after him, he tossed the youth down the cliff, forcing Cap to break off his pursuit to save his young friend. This proved to be the Torso's undoing as he lost his footing and began to tumble down the side of the mountain. Picking up snow along the way, he rolled into a massive snowball that crashed into his hideout, which then exploded in a massive fireball, killing the Torso and all his horrible abominations.

toru tarakoto.name: Toru Tarakoto
toru tarakoto.origin: Toru Tarakoto sought to take over Japan and purge it of foreign invaders. He became so fanatical in this desire that he allied himself with the Communist government of the People's Republic of China, who financed his development of Zoga the Unthinkable, a giant robotic dragon. Toru then adopted the costumed identity of the Monster Master. The energies utilized in creating Zoga were detected by Toru's research superior, Professor Goro Watanabe. Feigning ignorance, Toru helped Goro in establishing Project: Delta, apparently to investigate these energies. Toru, his lover Fujiko Watanabe and Goro were present in the laboratory of Fujiyama Industries, where Iron Man demonstrated the power of his tractor beams and energy rays. Toru suggested that Iron Man might help with Project: Delta. Iron Man agreed and accompanied them to a remote island in the Sea of Japan. As they investigated the island, Toru scouted ahead of everyone, then suddenly vanished. Soon afterwards, Zoga appeared and and attacked the others. Zoga incapacitated Iron Man and drove off the remaining members of the team. The Monster Master then guided Zoga back to a secret base operated by the Chinese. Toru later appeared to Goro and Fujiko, claiming to have been knocked unconscious during Zoga's attack. Later, Zoga appeared over Japan, assaulting an oil refinery, easily resisting Japan's air defenses. Iron Man flew after Zoga, but it managed to escaped his detection. Zoga was later detected and attacked by the Japanese Air Force. Iron Man followed the fight and confronted Zoga again, only to be knocked from the sky. Iron Man recovered and continued the assault, while Goro readied a weapon that Iron Man had instructed him to bring. Iron Man dodged Goro's next energy blast, which struck a parabolic mirror manned by Goro and was reflected back at Zoga's eye, causing Zoga to overheat and crash. Iron Man pulled the Monster Master from Zoga's head and unmasked him as Toru before he died.
abilities: Engineering: The Monster Master was a skilled scientist and engineer. : The Monster Master demonstrated great skill at piloting his robotic dragon.

toshi.name: Toshi
toshi.origin: Toshi was a cybernetically enhanced warrior serving as one of Tatsu'o's lieutenants. He resented Hiro's favored position and, together with Ko'ichi, saw an opportunity to advance within the clan when Hiro was temporarily disgraced and imprisoned. After Iceman infiltrated the Tatsu stronghold, Toshi attacked Hiro with energy harpoons, accusing him of betraying his fellow warriors because he had failed to kill Iceman during their previous encounter. Iceman intervened when Toshi and Ko'ichi turned against Hiro, freezing Toshi's arm and helping Hiro defeat the two attackers.

toshio sasaki.name: Toshio Sasaki
toshio sasaki.origin: Toshio Sasaki, along with his wife and child, were kidnapped by the villain Doctor Demonicus. Demonicus performed genetic experiments on the family and mutated them to gain superpowers. Toshio gained power to control air, so he was given name Taifu (the Japanese word for "Typhoon"). Toshio was forced to join Demonicus' Pacific Overlords, but eventually left. He attacked Demonicus' henchmen, but was defeated, captured and imprisoned in Demonicus' base. Eventually, when Avengers invaded the base they freed Toshio. Demonicus allowed him, Michi and their child to leave and retain their powers.
powers: Sasaki gained powers due to genetic experiments on him by Doctor Demonicus. He was able to generate blasts of air, powerful enough to hurl another person across a room.

toshiro kanada.origin: Toshiro Kanada was the planet manager of Stark Industries' Southeast Asia facility, whose supplies were being stolen by guerillas working for Wong Chu. toshiro mori.name: Toshiro Mori
toshiro mori.origin: Toshiro Mori was an Okinawa-based businessman with connections to Hydra. After a squad of Hydra operatives attacked the United Nations while disguised as S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, S.H.I.E.L.D. was able to track a specific kind of weapon used in the attack to Toshiro Mori. Agents Melinda May and Bobbi Morse and the mercenary Lance Hunter were sent to Okinawa to see what he knows about Hydra's plans. May and Hunter waited on the plane while Bobbi Morse, who knew Mori from her days working undercover at Hydra, flirted with him to get any information out of him. While he told her a team of Hydra agents were being sent to Belgium to kill Julien Beckers, Hunter intercepted a Hydra directive blowing her cover. Hunter barged in to save Bobbi, and with her cover blown she took down Mori. While Hunter and Bobbi began arguing, Mori attempted to raise his gun, only for the two to shoot him dead without looking.

tosin oduye.name: Tosin Oduye
tosin oduye.origin: Generations before his birth, Tosin's ancestors saw the greed and superiority of the Wakandans, due to their technological advancements. They observed Wakandans trying to bend Vibranium, to make it serve them. Tosin's ancestors shunned this and they removed themselves from the heart of Wakanda and settled in a mute zone of the country. This is where Tosin was born and raised, he did not experience the part of Wakanda which relied on technology and was isolated from the loop of craving power for one's desires. From afar, Tosin witnessed the wars and aliens that came to Wakanda. He and his tribe lived amongst the land and Vibranium, and they would find natural ways to refine its essence. Tosin and the people of his tribe would use Vibranium as a source for giving tattoos, which would ultimately give them powers. He and his tribe knew that war was going to come and they wanted to be able to protect Wakanda when that day arrived. alt=Young Tosin and his father training to flow with Vibranium|thumb|left|Young Tosin and his father training to flow with Vibranium When Wakanda moved from being a monarchy to a democracy, Tosin's elders did not believe that the "other Wakanda" could change and could not be redeemed. Tosin wanted to see Wakandan democracy for himself. He saw what he'd always seen, powerful men arguing about how they knew what was best for the country. Soon after, there was more war, violence and death. The prime minister, Falasade, declared that the time had come for the people of Wakanda to protect their country. Many in the Marube, wondered if they should help, but the Tribal Elder said that Birnin Zana had "brought destruction upon themselves." and to leave the capital of Wakanda to defend themselves. He believed that Wakanda wasn't just the country of proper Wakanda, it was his tribe's country, their home and their land. He believed that the time had come for a new hero of Wakanda to rise. He believed that choices had to be made, life's had to be put on the line and a revolution had to happen. War came to the Prime Minister's door, with enemies trying to force her surrender. This is when Tosin showed up. Using his powers, he used an energy blast to overwhelm the enemies. The enemies asked who he was. This is when he declared himself as Tosin, and that he fought for the one true Wakanda. During the war, Tosin came to the rescue of Shuri, who was ambushed by the Hatut Zeraze. After being rescued, Shuri offered to help Tosin, who declined her assistance. Tosin declared that he knew exactly who she was and that's why he doesn't trust her, but under the current circumstances, he would accept her help. Tosin then said that they were hopefully going somewhere safe. Shuri asked Tosin about the suit he was wearing, with him responding that it is actually his skin and that answers are not always found in a laboratory. He also states that he trusts science, but not to the exclusion of all other possibilities, and told her that her and T'Challa were the cause of the current conflict within Wakanda. With Shuri asking him if he's even Wakandan, Tosin replied by saying that he's more Wakandan than she'll ever be and whatever is happening in Wakanda, is his responsibility. Tosin and Shuri arrived at the home of the Marube tribe, where Tosin told Dahka that he needed to immerse in liquified vibranium. The Prime Minister said that the Marube went down the path of nature and unlocked vibranium in ways they never have. They then both say how Tosin rescued them. Tosin and the Marube tribe then prepared to join the showdown during the war against the Hatut Zeraze.

total elimination of super soldiers one.name: Total Elimination of Super-Soldiers-One
total elimination of super soldiers one.origin: When the Super-Soldier Project was first begun during WWII, there was a special meeting between President Roosevelt, top members of the War Department, and various scientists. One of the scientists, Professor Schumann, feared that once an army of Super-Soldiers won the war, they would return home and take over America. Schumann suggested the creation of a special robot, TESS (Total Elimination of Super-Soldiers), that would be built to neutralize super-soldiers. F.D.R. went ahead and okayed the suggested project. Unfortunately, the only man who knew how to create super-soldiers, Professor Erskine, was killed after creating only one super-soldier, Steve Rogers (Captain America). Now useless, the TESS project funds were cut off, and Schumann was ordered to destroy his work. Instead, the paranoid Schumann took his work to his home somewhere in the Midwest. He completed building the robot and programmed it to kill Captain America. Schumann eventually died and left the robot in a bomb shelter underneath his house. Years later, a retired agent of espionage organization SHIELD, Richard Rennselaer, somehow found out about Schumann's robot. Rennselaer was a mutant that could mentally control machines. Rennselaer's son, Johnny, had been afflicted with "Nuclear Psychosis," causing the boy to totally withdraw from reality. The psychosis was caused by the knowledge of the possibility of nuclear war and its effects. The desperate Rennselaer decided to use his powers to control Schumann's robot and make sure that the possibility of nuclear war was eliminated. He mentally activated the robot, and made it come to him. The robot left the underground bomb shelter, which was now located underneath the parking lot of a Kwikkie Burger. No one saw the robot leave, but everyone noticed the hole in the parking lot the next morning. Two men went down to investigate, but didn't come back up. Captain America's computer information network, Stars and Stripes, informed him about the apparent cave-in and the missing people. Captain America investigated and found the two men unconscious, knocked out by phosgene gas. Captain America rescued the men and then continued to explore the bomb shelter. After avoiding a few more death traps, Captain America discovered the room where the robot had been kept. From clues in the room, Captain America deduced that the room must have once contained a large robot. Captain America found out that the land had once belonged to a retired government man, named Schumann. Captain America then asked all the members of his Stars and Stripes network to be on the lookout for a large robot. Meanwhile, near Salem Center, New York, the X-Man known as Wolverine encountered Bob Frank, who was attacked by the patrons of a bar that Wolverine was at. Bob Frank had once been the super-powered mutant known as Nuklo, the son of the WWII hero, the Whizzer. Frank easily defeated the drunken men and wandered away from the bar. A curious Wolverine followed Frank through the woods. Nearby, Rennselaer, who now called himself Overrider, was preparing to hijack a semi-truck. He briefly lost control of Schumann's robot, which he called TESS. The wandering robot encountered Bob Frank and attacked him for some reason. Wolverine intervened and saved Frank, but the robot got away. Overrider gained control over TESS again, and hijacked a truck going to Adametco Metallurgy. Arriving at the company, Overrider forced some worker to coat TESS with a layer of Adamantium. Following different trails, Captain America and Wolverine arrived at Adametco just after TESS had been covered with the Adamantium. The two heroes fought TESS and Overrider, but the robot and its master were able to escape. Captain America and Wolverine split up to follow their own leads and met a day later. Captain America found out about the robot's origin, while Wolverine found out who Overrider was. Captain America was contacted by one of the members of his Stars and Stripes network, who had sighted TESS in the back of a van, near an air base in Nebraska. Wolverine and Captain America arrived at the base after Overrider had begun his attack. Working together, the two heroes were able to severe TESS's head, disabling the robot. Captain America and Wolverine stopped Overrider before he sent all of America's nuclear missiles to the bottom of the sea, without detonating them. ===Later Uses=== Much later after being placed in the custody of the US army, TESS was activated by the Super-Adaptoid, and made a member of a loose-knit team of robots, Heavy Metal. TESS and the robots were ordered by the Adaptoid to attack the hero team Avengers on their floating headquarters, Hydro-Base. She-Hulk and Marrina forced TESS off the island, causing the robot to plummet to the bottom of the ocean. The robot was later salvaged and repaired by Doctor Doom. Doom provided the robot with some new powers and sent it after Spider-Man, who had recently gained cosmic-level powers. Spider-Man easily de
powers: Tess-One is a robot originally designed as a possible defense against soldiers the U.S. government planned to enhance with the Super-Soldier Serum during World War II. As a result, the robot possesses various superhuman abilities.
TESS-One's hydraulics provided the robot with superhuman strength. At peak operating capacity, the robot possessed sufficient strength to lift 25 tons.

TESS-One was also equipped with built in thrusters that allowed it to fly through the air. Given the robot's great bulk, the thrusters were powerful and were capable of propelling it at speeds of at least 100 miles per hour.
abilities: Although TESS-One had lied dormant for decades, and was seemingly privative compared to more recent examples of robots, it was as efficient and highly effective in combat situations as when it was first created.

totem creature.name: Totem Creature
totem creature.origin: The Totem was reawakened by a Native American tribe's chieftain's prayers to chase two escaped convicts who had robbed them of their food and planned to kill them in the morning to eliminate witnesses to their flight. They returned to their jail cell, but the Totem tore the iron bars off their cell window while they shrank back in fear from its approach. Unexpectedly, the Totem broke off its attack on the two convicts and returned to menace the Native American village. The tribe hid in a cave while the chieftain concocted a potion to de-animate it. He caught up with the Totem as it was herding a bunch of hikers to their doom over a cliff and tossed the potion into one of its mouths, causing it to both topple over and fall off the cliff into the river. Although the chieftain had suffered a mortal injury in the process, he was satisfied that he had removed the threat that he had created as the Totem drifted out to sea.

toth crystal warrior man thing.name: Toth (Crystal Warrior-Man-Thing)
toth crystal warrior man thing.origin: Toth was the son of the Crystal Warrior Queen Blythir and a Man-Thing nicknamed "Mossy", who lived in the swamps of Weirdworld. He was one of the first students of Strange Academy and he had Germán as his roommate. With time, he grew closer to his classmate Shaylee Moonpeddle and, when visiting Asgard, she impulsively asked him to be her boyfriend, which he enthusiastically accepted. 200px|thumb|left|With Shaylee While studying late for a test, Toth accidentally found out that Calvin Morse's magical jacket was actually Mister Misery in disguise, so he shattered him, stealing his heart shard so he couldn't be revived. However, when Calvin accidentally found the shard in his pocket, Misery had to possess him and finally reveal himself to everyone. To defeat Misery, who was fed by the suffering of others, Dessy decided to feed him all the suffering in existence using her powers. As it became too much for him to handle, Calvin managed to break free, and, in the end, Dessy devoured Misery, ending the threat once and for all. With Toth fully restored, Calvin felt like an outcast, but Toth approached him to give him a hug and assure him everything was good between them. After Doctor Doom became Sorcerer Supreme, Toth was one of the students chosen to enroll in Doom Academy.
abilities: Swimming

toto mongolian.name: Toto (Mongolian)
toto mongolian.origin: Toto was a Mongolian bodyguard who served the Ring, a Nazi spy operating in the United States during World War II. A powerful fighter, Toto helped protect the Ring's operation and participated in the abduction of Bucky after the boy investigated their hideout in a curio shop. Toto threw the shop's owner, Hugo, through a display window and later helped hold Bucky and Captain America captive on Shoal Island. During the heroes' pursuit of the Ring, Toto fought Captain America but was defeated and forced to reveal the deadly mechanism of the cobra rings and the location of the Ring's next hideout.
